Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And God said, Let there be _____: and there was light.
Cold Open.verse: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
Cold Open.note: God's first spoken words in Scripture — day one, and the lights come on.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So God created man in his own _____, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
Cold Open.verse: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
Cold Open.note: Imago Dei — every person you meet today carries it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Honour thy father and thy _____: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Cold Open.verse: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Cold Open.note: The fifth commandment — the first one, Paul notes, that comes with a promise attached.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be strong and of a good _____, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
Cold Open.verse: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
Cold Open.note: Moses' send-off to Israel — the same charge God repeats to Joshua on the far side of the Jordan.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small _____.
Cold Open.verse: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
Cold Open.note: Not the wind, the earthquake, or the fire — God met Elijah in a still small voice.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Yea, though I walk through the _____ of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Cold Open.verse: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Cold Open.note: The shepherd psalm turns dark here — but notice the walk is THROUGH the valley, not into it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thy word is a _____ unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Cold Open.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Cold Open.note: A lamp for the feet: enough light for the next step, not the whole road.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be _____, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
Cold Open.verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
Cold Open.note: 'Be still' here means 'cease striving' — a command, and a kindness.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will _____ and be glad in it.
Cold Open.verse: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Cold Open.note: The sung-before-breakfast verse — rejoicing here is a decision, made daily.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy _____.
Cold Open.verse: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Cold Open.note: The verse right after 'Trust in the LORD' — acknowledge him, and he handles the map.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A soft answer turneth away _____: but grievous words stir up anger.
Cold Open.verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
Cold Open.note: Soft answers cost nothing and defuse everything — grievous words do the opposite.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A merry heart doeth good like a _____: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
Cold Open.verse: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
Cold Open.note: Cheerfulness as pharmacy — the KJV prescribes a merry heart.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Train up a _____ in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
Cold Open.verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
Cold Open.note: The parenting verse taped to a million refrigerators.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the _____ shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
Cold Open.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
Cold Open.note: Handel set this one to music — the Christmas prophecy, seven hundred years early.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: All we like _____ have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
Cold Open.verse: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
Cold Open.note: The suffering servant chapter — we wander like sheep; he carries the iniquity.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thou wilt keep him in perfect _____, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Cold Open.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Cold Open.note: The Hebrew doubles it — 'shalom shalom': peace, and then peace again.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Call unto me, and I will _____ thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
Cold Open.verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
Cold Open.note: Sometimes nicknamed 'God's phone number' — call, and he answers with great and mighty things.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let your light so _____ before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
Cold Open.verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
Cold Open.note: From the Sermon on the Mount — the light is for showing, the glory is for God.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But seek ye first the _____ of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Cold Open.verse: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Cold Open.note: 'Seek ye first' — the ordering of priorities that makes everything else 'added.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; _____, and it shall be opened unto you:
Cold Open.verse: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
Cold Open.note: Ask, seek, knock — the verbs escalate, and the initials happen to spell ASK.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you _____.
Cold Open.verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Cold Open.note: The gentlest invitation in the Gospels — rest, offered to the heavy laden.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little _____ to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
Cold Open.verse: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
Cold Open.note: 'Suffer' is KJV for 'allow' — Jesus was pro-children, not pro-suffering.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the _____ to every creature.
Cold Open.verse: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
Cold Open.note: The Great Commission, Mark's edition — all the world, every creature.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For with God nothing shall be _____.
Cold Open.verse: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
Cold Open.note: Gabriel's word to Mary — a good line to keep within reach.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them _____.
Cold Open.verse: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
Cold Open.note: The Golden Rule, Luke's edition — do first, as you'd have done to you.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was _____.
Cold Open.verse: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
Cold Open.note: Spoken at Zacchaeus' house — the whole mission statement in one line.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the _____, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
Cold Open.verse: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
Cold Open.note: Way, truth, life — three nouns, each with a definite article, no alternates offered.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Jesus _____.
Cold Open.verse: Jesus wept.
Cold Open.note: The shortest verse in the Bible — and one of the most human.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you _____.
Cold Open.verse: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
Cold Open.note: Truth and freedom, permanently linked — quoted on university walls everywhere.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his _____.
Cold Open.verse: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
Cold Open.note: Said the night before he went and did exactly that.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be _____, and thy house.
Cold Open.verse: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
Cold Open.note: The Philippian jailer asked what to do — the answer fit in one sentence.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to _____.
Cold Open.verse: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
Cold Open.note: A saying of Jesus preserved outside the Gospels — Paul quotes it from memory in Acts.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For all have _____, and come short of the glory of God;
Cold Open.verse: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
Cold Open.note: The great leveler — 'all' is why the Romans Road starts here.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For the _____ of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Cold Open.verse: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Cold Open.note: Sin pays wages; God gives a gift — the contrast is the whole gospel.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet _____, Christ died for us.
Cold Open.verse: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Cold Open.note: Not after we cleaned up — 'while we were yet sinners.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with _____.
Cold Open.verse: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
Cold Open.note: Evil isn't outrun or out-argued — it's overcome, and good is the weapon.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Charity suffereth long, and is _____; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
Cold Open.verse: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
Cold Open.note: The love chapter — 'charity' is KJV for agape, and it leads with patience.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let all your things be done with _____.
Cold Open.verse: Let all your things be done with charity.
Cold Open.note: 'Charity' is how the KJV says agape — love with its sleeves rolled up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new _____: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
Cold Open.verse: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
Cold Open.note: 'Creature' is KJV for 'creation' — brand new, with the old things gone.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But the _____ of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
Cold Open.verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
Cold Open.note: Fruit, singular — one crop with nine flavors.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also _____.
Cold Open.verse: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
Cold Open.note: The law of the harvest — the seed and the crop always match.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Put on the whole _____ of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Cold Open.verse: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Cold Open.note: The whole armour — Paul itemizes the pieces a few verses later.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And be ye kind one to another, _____, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
Cold Open.verse: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
Cold Open.note: One glorious KJV compound word — kindness with the heart turned all the way up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
Cold Open.verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
Cold Open.note: Paul says it twice in one verse — written from prison, no less.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the peace of God, which passeth all _____, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
Cold Open.verse: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
Cold Open.note: A peace that doesn't explain itself — it stands guard instead.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And whatsoever ye do, do it _____, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
Cold Open.verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
Cold Open.note: 'Heartily' — the KJV's word for doing Monday's work as if it were for the Lord.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In every thing give _____: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Cold Open.verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Cold Open.note: In every thing, not FOR every thing — a small preposition doing heavy lifting.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
Cold Open.verse: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
Cold Open.note: 'Study' here means 'be diligent' — though the reading habit doesn't hurt either.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Jesus Christ the same _____, and to day, and for ever.
Cold Open.verse: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
Cold Open.note: The unchanging Christ — and yes, 'to day' is two words in the KJV, charmingly.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Every good _____ and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
Cold Open.verse: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
Cold Open.note: Every good gift traces upstream to the Father of lights.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thou shalt not _____.
Cold Open.verse: Thou shalt not kill.
Cold Open.note: The commandment against killing — four words in the KJV, about as short as law gets.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Children, _____ your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
Cold Open.verse: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
Cold Open.note: Paul quotes the fifth commandment in the next verse — the one with the promise.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For in him we live, and _____, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
Cold Open.verse: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
Cold Open.note: Paul on Mars' Hill, quoting Greek poets to Athenians — meeting his audience where they lived.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above _____.
Cold Open.verse: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
Cold Open.note: The opening line of the virtuous woman poem — an acrostic running through the Hebrew alphabet.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: My brethren, count it all _____ when ye fall into divers temptations;
Cold Open.verse: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
Cold Open.note: James opens his letter with the strangest instruction — count trials as joy.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Cold Open.verse: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Cold Open.note: David's reminder of who holds the deed — Paul quotes it in 1 Corinthians 10 over a question about meat.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come _____. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Cold Open.verse: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Cold Open.note: The Bible's last promise — and the next-to-last verse in the whole book.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Before I formed thee in the _____ I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
Cold Open.verse: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
Cold Open.note: Jeremiah's call — known before he was formed; the KJV says 'belly' first and 'womb' second.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A new _____ I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
Cold Open.verse: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
Cold Open.note: Given at the Last Supper — 'new' because of the measure: as I have loved you.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy _____, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
Cold Open.verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
Cold Open.note: The Preacher's advice to the young — remember your Creator before the hard days arrive.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away _____ things.
Cold Open.verse: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
Cold Open.note: Tucked into the love chapter — growing up in love means putting childish things away.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Bear ye one another's _____, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Cold Open.verse: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Cold Open.note: Shared weight is lighter weight — Paul calls that fulfilling the law of Christ.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For I am not _____ of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Cold Open.verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Cold Open.note: Paul wrote this to Rome before he ever visited — the theme verse of the whole letter.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Blessed are the _____ in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
Cold Open.verse: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
Cold Open.note: The first Beatitude — the Sermon on the Mount opens with a blessing for the spiritually broke.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But I say unto you, Love your _____, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
Cold Open.verse: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
Cold Open.note: The hardest line in the Sermon on the Mount — love aimed at the people least likely to return it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Take therefore no thought for the _____: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
Cold Open.verse: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
Cold Open.note: 'Morrow' is KJV for tomorrow — and tomorrow, Jesus says, can do its own worrying.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be _____ for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
Cold Open.verse: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
Cold Open.note: 'Careful' is KJV for 'anxious' — trade the worry for prayer with thanksgiving.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD God formed man of the _____ of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
Cold Open.note: Adam's origin story — a handful of earth plus the breath of God equals a living soul.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Jesus said unto her, I am the _____, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
Cold Open.verse: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
Cold Open.note: Spoken to Martha at Lazarus' tomb — four days in, and about to be very much alive.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I am _____ with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
Cold Open.verse: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
Cold Open.note: Paul's most personal summary of the gospel — 'who loved me' is singular on purpose.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his _____ over me was love.
Cold Open.verse: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
Cold Open.note: The banqueting house verse — a favorite Sunday school chorus with a love banner flying high.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be ye _____, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
Cold Open.verse: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
Cold Open.note: Anger isn't banned here — just given a sundown curfew.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy _____ as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
Cold Open.verse: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
Cold Open.note: The second great commandment — Jesus pairs it with loving God and says none is greater.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: If we confess our sins, he is _____ and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Cold Open.verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Cold Open.note: Confession meets a faithful God — and the cleansing covers all unrighteousness.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by _____ alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
Cold Open.verse: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
Cold Open.note: Jesus answers the tempter by quoting Deuteronomy — after forty days of fasting, no less.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is _____.
Cold Open.verse: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
Cold Open.note: Written from chains — Paul sees a win either way, living or dying.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I _____, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
Cold Open.verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
Cold Open.note: Isaiah's call in the temple — he volunteers before he even knows the assignment.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt _____ therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
Cold Open.verse: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
Cold Open.note: Joshua's marching orders after Moses died — success, it turns out, starts with a book.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, I stand at the _____, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Cold Open.verse: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Cold Open.note: Spoken to lukewarm Laodicea — Jesus knocking, waiting for the latch to lift.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For my _____ are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
Cold Open.note: God's ways and ours don't run on the same map — and the next verse says how far apart they are.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of _____: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Cold Open.verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Cold Open.note: The motto of the whole book of Proverbs — wisdom's first lesson is reverence.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good _____, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
Cold Open.verse: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
Cold Open.note: Pressed down, shaken together, running over — a grain-market picture of generous giving.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: There hath no _____ taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
Cold Open.verse: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
Cold Open.note: Nothing you face is unheard of, Paul says — and there's always a way out.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more _____.
Cold Open.verse: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
Cold Open.note: The thief takes; the Good Shepherd gives life — and more of it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be _____ again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
Cold Open.verse: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
Cold Open.note: Said to Nicodemus, who came by night — and promptly asked how a grown man manages it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: What? know ye not that your body is the _____ of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
Cold Open.verse: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
Cold Open.note: Paul's reminder to Corinth — the body is a dwelling place, not a rental to trash.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very _____. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
Cold Open.verse: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
Cold Open.note: Day six ends with the Creator's review: not just good this time, but very good.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a _____ shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
Cold Open.verse: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
Cold Open.note: The Immanuel sign — Matthew quotes it in his telling of the first Christmas.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the _____ and the sea obey him?
Cold Open.verse: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
Cold Open.note: Right after 'Peace, be still' — calmer seas, and somehow more frightened fishermen.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then said Jesus, Father, _____ them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
Cold Open.verse: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
Cold Open.note: The first of Jesus' sayings from the cross — mercy for the very people driving the nails.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Cold Open.verse: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Cold Open.note: Everything green fades eventually — the word of God is the one thing that doesn't.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in _____!
Cold Open.verse: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
Cold Open.note: A Song of Degrees for pilgrims headed to Jerusalem — brotherly harmony, compared to precious oil and mountain dew.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
Cold Open.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
Cold Open.note: David's sky-watching psalm — the stars preach a sermon every night without saying a word.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the _____ was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
Cold Open.verse: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
Cold Open.note: Forty days and nights of rain — the number shows up again with Moses on Sinai and Jesus in the wilderness.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Glory to God in the _____, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Cold Open.verse: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Cold Open.note: The angels' song over Bethlehem's shepherds — the original Gloria in Excelsis.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And I will make of thee a great _____, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
Cold Open.verse: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
Cold Open.note: God's call to Abram — one childless old man, promised a great nation and a great name.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For where your _____ is, there will your heart be also.
Cold Open.verse: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
Cold Open.note: Follow the money and you'll find the heart — Jesus said it first.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is _____, being alone.
Cold Open.verse: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
Cold Open.note: James at his bluntest — faith without works isn't resting, it's dead.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But Noah found _____ in the eyes of the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
Cold Open.note: The first time 'grace' appears in the KJV — and it lands on Noah, just before the flood.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Create in me a _____ heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Cold Open.verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Cold Open.note: David's prayer after his sin with Bathsheba — he asks for a new heart, not a fresh coat of paint.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without _____.
Cold Open.verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
Cold Open.note: God's open invitation to the thirsty — come buy wine and milk, and bring no money.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and _____,
Cold Open.verse: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
Cold Open.note: Job's first response to losing everything — grief, and then worship, before a single word.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the _____, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
Cold Open.verse: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
Cold Open.note: Jesus read this passage aloud in the Nazareth synagogue, then said it was fulfilled that day.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For if our heart condemn us, God is _____ than our heart, and knoweth all things.
Cold Open.verse: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
Cold Open.note: When your own heart condemns you, God is greater — and he knows everything.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
Cold Open.verse: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
Cold Open.note: The Shema — Israel's great confession, recited daily for millennia, and quoted by Jesus as the first commandment.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the _____, to go to Jesus.
Cold Open.verse: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
Cold Open.note: Peter steps out of the boat — the only disciple who tried walking on the water.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But above all things, my brethren, _____ not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
Cold Open.verse: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
Cold Open.note: James echoes the Sermon on the Mount — let your yes mean yes.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all _____.
Cold Open.verse: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
Cold Open.note: Eve's name sounds like the Hebrew word for 'living' — Adam named her with a hope, even after the fall.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: What is man, that thou art _____ of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
Cold Open.verse: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
Cold Open.note: David under the night sky, amazed God notices us at all — Hebrews 2 quotes this verse.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And when the _____, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
Cold Open.verse: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
Cold Open.note: A Roman officer at the foot of the cross gives the Gospel's great verdict.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Is any sick among you? let him call for the _____ of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
Cold Open.verse: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
Cold Open.note: James' instructions for the sick — call the church elders, pray, and anoint with oil.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his _____, and follow me.
Cold Open.verse: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
Cold Open.note: Deny, take up, follow — spoken right after Peter tried to talk Jesus out of the cross.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Blessed is he that _____, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
Cold Open.verse: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
Cold Open.note: Revelation opens with a blessing on whoever reads it aloud and whoever listens.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the _____ is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
Cold Open.verse: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
Cold Open.note: The swift don't always win, nor the strong — time and chance happen to everyone.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the _____.
Cold Open.verse: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Cold Open.note: The last chapter of Exodus — Moses finishes the tabernacle, and the glory cloud moves in.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But thou, O man of God, _____ these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
Cold Open.verse: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
Cold Open.note: Run from the love of money, run toward godliness — Paul's two-way race for Timothy.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be _____,
Cold Open.verse: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
Cold Open.note: A mystery revealed — not everyone will die, but everyone will be changed.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and _____ my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
Cold Open.verse: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
Cold Open.note: Young Jeremiah protested that he was just a child — so God touched his mouth and filled it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a _____ upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
Cold Open.verse: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
Cold Open.note: At Jesus' baptism the Spirit descends in bodily shape like a dove — and the Father speaks.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For this is the _____ that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
Cold Open.verse: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
Cold Open.note: The oldest message in the church — love one another, heard from the beginning.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy _____ shall be established for ever.
Cold Open.verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
Cold Open.note: God's covenant with David — a house, a kingdom, and a throne established for ever.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot _____, promised before the world began;
Cold Open.verse: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
Cold Open.note: Eternal life promised before the world began — by the one God who cannot lie.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Every man shall give as he is _____, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
Cold Open.verse: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
Cold Open.note: The pilgrim-feast rule for giving — not a fixed price, but in proportion to how you've been blessed.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too _____ for thee:
Cold Open.verse: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
Cold Open.note: Jeremiah prays this while buying a field in a city about to fall — faith with a deed attached.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And that from a child thou hast known the holy _____, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Cold Open.verse: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Cold Open.note: Timothy learned the scriptures early — Paul credits his grandmother Lois and mother Eunice.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the _____.
Cold Open.verse: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
Cold Open.note: Job remembers better days — he was eyes for the blind and feet for the lame.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the _____ of the law.
Cold Open.verse: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
Cold Open.note: Love never harms a neighbour — which is why it fulfils the whole law.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is _____ of all.
Cold Open.verse: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
Cold Open.note: Break one link and the whole chain is broken — James on keeping the law.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The people that walked in _____ have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
Cold Open.verse: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
Cold Open.note: Matthew quotes this when Jesus begins preaching in Galilee — a great light for people in the dark.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with _____, and with weeping, and with mourning:
Cold Open.verse: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
Cold Open.note: Joel's call to return — and the next verse says rend your heart, not your garments.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In whose _____ is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
Cold Open.verse: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
Cold Open.note: Job's answer to his friends — even the beasts know whose hand holds every living breath.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the _____,
Cold Open.verse: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
Cold Open.note: Hebrews opens with history — God spoke many ways before speaking through his Son.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And having food and raiment let us be therewith _____.
Cold Open.verse: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
Cold Open.note: Food and clothing — Paul's whole list of essentials for a contented life.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never _____. Believest thou this?
Cold Open.verse: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
Cold Open.note: Jesus to Martha, four days after Lazarus died — and she answered with a full confession of faith.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his _____ was not arrayed like one of these.
Cold Open.verse: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
Cold Open.note: Consider the lilies — Israel's most splendid king couldn't match a wildflower's outfit.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: This beginning of _____ did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
Cold Open.verse: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
Cold Open.note: Water into wine at a wedding in Cana — the first of the signs in John's Gospel.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let the words of my mouth, and the _____ of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
Cold Open.verse: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
Cold Open.note: The closing prayer of the sky-and-Scripture psalm — many a sermon still begins with it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a _____, and there is none abiding.
Cold Open.verse: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
Cold Open.note: David, near the end of his reign, admits that kings are just passing through too.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thou shalt not bear _____ witness against thy neighbour.
Cold Open.verse: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
Cold Open.note: 'Bear false witness' is courtroom language — but the commandment covers the backyard fence too.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than _____ to my mouth!
Cold Open.verse: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
Cold Open.note: Scripture as dessert — Ezekiel said the same after eating a scroll that tasted like honey.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But ye, beloved, _____ up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
Cold Open.verse: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
Cold Open.note: Jude's construction advice — build yourselves up on your most holy faith.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Pilate saith unto him, What is _____? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
Cold Open.verse: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
Cold Open.note: Pilate's famous question — asked of the one who had said, 'I am the way, the truth, and the life.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were _____.
Cold Open.verse: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
Cold Open.note: The Red Sea crossing — note the strong east wind blew all night; the miracle had a night shift.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the _____.
Cold Open.verse: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
Cold Open.note: Christ didn't wait for us to get strong — he died for the ungodly.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And all that believed were together, and had all things _____;
Cold Open.verse: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
Cold Open.note: The first believers shared everything — Acts says no one among them lacked.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be _____: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
Cold Open.verse: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
Cold Open.note: Isaiah's short song of thanksgiving — it echoes the very words Moses sang after the Red Sea crossing.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Favour is _____, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
Cold Open.verse: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
Cold Open.note: The last word on the virtuous woman — charm fades, beauty passes, reverence lasts.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For, lo, the _____ is past, the rain is over and gone;
Cold Open.verse: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
Cold Open.note: The next line in the beloved's call — winter's over, the rain is gone, and the flowers are up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Faithful are the _____ of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
Cold Open.verse: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
Cold Open.note: An honest friend's sting beats an enemy's flattering kisses.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the _____ that is on the sea shore.
Cold Open.verse: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
Cold Open.note: Solomon's wisdom, measured in beach sand — the same image God used for Abraham's descendants.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and _____ of all.
Cold Open.verse: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
Cold Open.note: The disciples had argued about who was greatest — so Jesus sat down and redefined the word.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of _____ that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
Cold Open.verse: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
Cold Open.note: Faith tested like gold in a furnace — and worth far more than gold.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a _____ woman.
Cold Open.verse: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.
Cold Open.note: Boaz's tribute to Ruth — the same phrase crowns the 'virtuous woman' poem in Proverbs 31.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell _____.
Cold Open.verse: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
Cold Open.note: Stephen's last words echo Jesus' own prayer from the cross — forgiveness for his killers.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in _____ seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
Cold Open.verse: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
Cold Open.note: Naaman wanted a showy healing — he got told to take seven dips in the Jordan, and stormed off insulted.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our _____: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
Cold Open.verse: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
Cold Open.note: 'Let us make man' — the only creation act with a divine conversation before it, and the image comes with a job: dominion.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the _____ fallen!
Cold Open.verse: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
Cold Open.note: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan — 'how are the mighty fallen' repeats three times in the song.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I _____ him out of the water.
Cold Open.verse: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
Cold Open.note: Pharaoh's daughter names the baby from the basket — Moses, because she drew him out of the water.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For the LORD God is a sun and _____: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
Cold Open.verse: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
Cold Open.note: From the pilgrims' psalm that prefers a day in God's courts to a thousand anywhere else.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our _____; and we all are the work of thy hand.
Cold Open.verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
Cold Open.note: A prayer of surrender — we're the clay, and the potter is also our Father.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love _____ one another.
Cold Open.verse: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
Cold Open.note: Freedom isn't a license — Paul says its best use is serving one another.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and _____ about many things:
Cold Open.verse: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
Cold Open.note: Martha's busy kitchen — Jesus says only one thing is needful, and Mary had chosen it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the _____.
Cold Open.verse: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
Cold Open.note: Desert flowers in prophecy — the wilderness breaking into bloom when God redeems.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For God sent not his Son into the world to _____ the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
Cold Open.verse: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
Cold Open.note: The verse right after John 3:16 — the mission was rescue, not condemnation.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the _____ fly upward.
Cold Open.verse: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
Cold Open.note: Eliphaz, the first of Job's friends to speak — true enough on trouble, wrong about why Job had it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And as Moses lifted up the _____ in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
Cold Open.verse: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
Cold Open.note: Jesus points Nicodemus back to Numbers 21 — the brass serpent lifted up for healing.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no _____, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
Cold Open.verse: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
Cold Open.note: Too many sheep, not enough pasture — Abram settles it by letting his nephew Lot choose first.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Whoso findeth a _____ findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
Cold Open.note: A short, sweet proverb about marriage — finding a wife is finding a good thing.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; _____ to that which is good.
Cold Open.verse: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
Cold Open.note: Love without faking it — hate the evil, and hold on tight to the good.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
Cold Open.verse: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
Cold Open.note: Nothing slips past heaven's notice — the evil and the good alike.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of _____.
Cold Open.verse: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
Cold Open.note: Jesus clearing the temple — quoting Isaiah 56 and Jeremiah 7 as he did it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I and my Father are _____.
Cold Open.verse: I and my Father are one.
Cold Open.note: Six words that nearly got Jesus stoned — the crowd picked up rocks in the very next verse.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is _____, and in him is no darkness at all.
Cold Open.verse: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
Cold Open.note: John's message in one line — God is light, with no shadows at all.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Therefore they that were _____ abroad went every where preaching the word.
Cold Open.verse: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
Cold Open.note: Persecution scattered the church — and the scattered church preached everywhere it landed.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath _____, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
Cold Open.verse: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
Cold Open.note: An invitation to come home — the God who tore is the God who heals.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an _____ spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
Cold Open.verse: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
Cold Open.note: Daniel's excellence made the other officials jealous — and that's how the lions' den came about.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And ye shall _____ them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
Cold Open.verse: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
Cold Open.note: Faith as an all-day conversation — sitting, walking, lying down, getting up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I am the true _____, and my Father is the husbandman.
Cold Open.verse: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
Cold Open.note: One of Jesus' 'I am' sayings — with the Father as the husbandman tending the vineyard.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he is the _____ of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
Cold Open.verse: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
Cold Open.note: Christ is head of the body, the church — first in creation and first from the dead.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He that spareth his _____ hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
Cold Open.verse: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
Cold Open.note: An old line on discipline — the point is love that bothers to correct.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their _____ is come up before me.
Cold Open.verse: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
Cold Open.note: Jonah's assignment — go to Nineveh; he immediately bought a ticket to the opposite end of the map.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the _____ is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
Cold Open.verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
Cold Open.note: Jeremiah watched a potter remake a marred pot — and God said, 'That's my people.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good _____, and do it.
Cold Open.verse: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
Cold Open.note: Ezra was on his face weeping over the people's sin — Shechaniah tells him to get up, take heart, and lead.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no _____; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
Cold Open.verse: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
Cold Open.note: Three men thrown into the furnace, four men walking around in it — and not even the smell of smoke on them afterward.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A time to be born, and a time to _____; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
Cold Open.verse: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
Cold Open.note: The second verse of 'a time for everything' — the list starts at birth and works from there.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let all _____, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
Cold Open.verse: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
Cold Open.note: Paul's list of things to take out with the trash — six of them, starting with bitterness.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For then will I turn to the people a pure _____, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
Cold Open.verse: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
Cold Open.note: A promise to reverse Babel — one pure language, everyone calling on the LORD together.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The fear of the LORD is the _____ of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
Cold Open.verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
Cold Open.note: A close cousin of the book's motto — wisdom starts with reverence for the LORD.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Honour all men. Love the _____. Fear God. Honour the king.
Cold Open.verse: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
Cold Open.note: Four quick commands — honour everyone, love the church, fear God, honour the king.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for _____.
Cold Open.verse: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
Cold Open.note: Friends love at all times — and brothers are born for the hard days.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The LORD is _____, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
Cold Open.verse: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
Cold Open.note: Moses quotes God's own self-description from Sinai back to him while pleading for Israel's pardon.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh _____;
Cold Open.verse: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
Cold Open.note: Paul's chain reaction — tribulation, patience, experience, hope — and hope doesn't disappoint.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without _____ of the church unto God for him.
Cold Open.verse: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
Cold Open.note: Peter in Herod's prison, the church on its knees — an angel showed up that night.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: With all lowliness and meekness, with _____, forbearing one another in love;
Cold Open.verse: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
Cold Open.note: Four virtues for keeping church family together — longsuffering is patience that goes the distance.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great _____, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
Cold Open.verse: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
Cold Open.note: A crowd no one could count, from every nation — all in white, before the throne.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the _____ of God is stronger than men.
Cold Open.verse: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
Cold Open.note: God's 'foolishness' outsmarts us, and his 'weakness' outmuscles us.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I was _____ when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
Cold Open.note: A pilgrim's Song of Degrees — sung on the road up to Jerusalem's temple.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Be ye _____ of me, even as I also am of Christ.
Cold Open.verse: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
Cold Open.note: Paul's bold invitation — copy me, as I copy Christ.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the _____ of all thine increase:
Cold Open.verse: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
Cold Open.note: Honour from the top of the harvest, not the leftovers — just a few verses after 'Trust in the LORD.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all _____, no man forbidding him.
Cold Open.verse: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
Cold Open.note: The last verse of Acts — Paul under house arrest in Rome, still preaching freely.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A bruised _____ shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
Cold Open.verse: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
Cold Open.note: Matthew applies this to Jesus — gentle enough not to snap a cracked reed or snuff a smoking wick.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In the _____ was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Cold Open.verse: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Cold Open.note: John opens like Genesis — 'In the beginning' — and then introduces the Word.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All _____ is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
Cold Open.verse: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
Cold Open.note: The lead-in to the Great Commission — all power given, so 'go ye therefore' follows.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her _____ by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
Cold Open.verse: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
Cold Open.note: A tree that doesn't panic in drought — 'careful' here is KJV for worried.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
Cold Open.verse: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
Cold Open.note: Hand over the whole road, not just the next step — then trust him to bring it to pass.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a _____ at her.
Cold Open.verse: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
Cold Open.note: Jesus' answer to the accusers — and one by one, from the eldest on down, they all walked away.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Beloved, if God so loved us, we _____ also to love one another.
Cold Open.verse: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
Cold Open.note: If God loved like that, John says, the obligation is obvious.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put _____.
Cold Open.verse: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
Cold Open.note: Jesus on marriage, right after quoting Genesis 2 — what God joins, people shouldn't pull apart.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Blow ye the _____ in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
