Cold Open.verse: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
Cold Open.note: Joel's alarm — the trumpet in Zion, warning that the day of the LORD is near.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he shall be like a _____ planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
Cold Open.verse: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
Cold Open.note: The very first psalm sketches the righteous as a riverside tree — Jeremiah borrows the picture later.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Her children arise up, and call her _____; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
Cold Open.verse: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
Cold Open.note: The virtuous woman's family review — five stars from the children and the husband.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Beloved, _____ not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
Cold Open.verse: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
Cold Open.note: John's simple test — imitate the good, not the evil.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Who shall _____ us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
Cold Open.verse: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
Cold Open.note: Paul lists every threat he can think of — none can separate us from Christ's love.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy _____, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
Cold Open.verse: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
Cold Open.note: Jesus' prayer advice — shut the door; the Father sees what's done in secret.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a _____ heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
Cold Open.verse: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
Cold Open.note: David learned the one sacrifice God always accepts is a broken and contrite heart.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my _____ one, and come away.
Cold Open.verse: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
Cold Open.note: The beloved calls at the window — spring has come, so come away.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For I have given you an _____, that ye should do as I have done to you.
Cold Open.verse: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
Cold Open.note: After washing the disciples' feet, Jesus called it an example — do as I have done.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Rejoiceth not in _____, but rejoiceth in the truth;
Cold Open.verse: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
Cold Open.note: Love doesn't enjoy anyone's downfall — it celebrates what's true.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: My God, my God, why hast thou _____ me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
Cold Open.verse: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
Cold Open.note: The cry Jesus prayed from the cross — a psalm that ends, remarkably, in praise.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new _____ with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
Cold Open.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
Cold Open.note: The new covenant promise — Hebrews 8 quotes the whole passage, often called the longest OT quotation in the New Testament.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as _____ in the world;
Cold Open.verse: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
Cold Open.note: Shining like stars in a crooked world — Paul's picture of a faithful church.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be _____ among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
Cold Open.verse: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
Cold Open.note: The chief priests quoted this to Herod when the wise men asked where the king would be born.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
Cold Open.verse: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
Cold Open.note: The whole book of Obadiah is one chapter — and it starts with Edom's pride in its cliffside cities.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was _____ and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
Cold Open.verse: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
Cold Open.note: The opening of Job — the land of Uz, a good man, and no hint yet of the storm coming.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to _____;
Cold Open.verse: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
Cold Open.note: From the 'season' poem the Byrds turned into the 1965 hit 'Turn! Turn! Turn!'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to _____ it and to keep it.
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
Cold Open.note: Work came before the fall, not after it — Adam's first job description was to dress and keep a garden.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The last _____ that shall be destroyed is death.
Cold Open.verse: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
Cold Open.note: Death is on the list too — the last enemy, scheduled for destruction.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
Cold Open.verse: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
Cold Open.note: Peter quotes the second half: charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am _____.
Cold Open.verse: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
Cold Open.note: Mountain-moving faith without love adds up to exactly nothing.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye _____ not.
Cold Open.verse: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
Cold Open.note: James' blunt diagnosis — some go without simply because they never asked God.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and _____ us.
Cold Open.verse: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
Cold Open.note: Paul's night vision — the call that sent his team across the sea to Macedonia.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He revealeth the deep and _____ things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
Cold Open.verse: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
Cold Open.note: Daniel's praise after God revealed Nebuchadnezzar's dream to him by night.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the _____ day according to the scriptures:
Cold Open.verse: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
Cold Open.note: Paul's gospel summary — buried, and risen the third day, just as the scriptures said.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and _____ shall be increased.
Cold Open.verse: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
Cold Open.note: Seal the book until the end — when many will run to and fro and knowledge will grow.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me _____, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
Cold Open.verse: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
Cold Open.note: God's word is like rain and snow — it always comes back having done its job.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thou shalt not _____.
Cold Open.verse: Thou shalt not steal.
Cold Open.note: One of the shortest of the Ten Commandments — four words, no loopholes.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be _____, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
Cold Open.verse: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
Cold Open.note: Discipline doesn't feel joyous at the time — the fruit comes afterward.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I _____ him? till seven times?
Cold Open.verse: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
Cold Open.note: Peter thought seven times was generous — Jesus answered with seventy times seven.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may _____ that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
Cold Open.verse: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
Cold Open.note: Not hope-so but know-so — John wrote this letter for assurance.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then Gideon built an _____ there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Cold Open.verse: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Cold Open.note: Gideon's altar, named Jehovah-shalom — 'the LORD is peace' — built while Midianites still ruled the land.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a _____ that breaketh the rock in pieces?
Cold Open.verse: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
Cold Open.note: God's word as fire and hammer — no gentle suggestion here.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Abide in me, and I in you. As the _____ cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
Cold Open.verse: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
Cold Open.note: A branch doesn't strain to grow grapes — it just stays connected to the vine.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for _____, and things wherewith one may edify another.
Cold Open.verse: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
Cold Open.note: Pursue what makes for peace — and what builds each other up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of _____.
Cold Open.verse: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
Cold Open.note: Job's sober math on the human condition — short on days, long on trouble.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a _____ the foal of an ass.
Cold Open.verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
Cold Open.note: Fulfilled on Palm Sunday — Matthew and John both quote it as Jesus rides into Jerusalem.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For it is God which _____ in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
Cold Open.verse: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
Cold Open.note: Right after 'work out your own salvation' — Paul says it's God doing the work within.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be _____; I will make him an help meet for him.
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
Cold Open.note: The first 'not good' in the Bible — after six days of 'good,' solitude is the one thing God corrects.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, _____ me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
Cold Open.verse: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
Cold Open.note: The thief's request on the cross — and Jesus' answer comes in the very next verse.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But when thou doest alms, let not thy _____ hand know what thy right hand doeth:
Cold Open.verse: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
Cold Open.note: Giving in secret — so quietly that even your other hand doesn't hear about it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he _____ on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
Cold Open.verse: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
Cold Open.note: The first sabbath — God rests on day seven, not from weariness but because the work was finished.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my _____ out of Egypt.
Cold Open.verse: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
Cold Open.note: Matthew sees this fulfilled when the young Jesus returns from Egypt with Mary and Joseph.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a _____ unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
Cold Open.verse: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
Cold Open.note: Ezekiel's job title — a watchman on the wall, warning the city of what's coming.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD shall be _____ over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
Cold Open.note: The prophecy's grand finale — one LORD, one name, King over all the earth.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly _____:
Cold Open.verse: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
Cold Open.note: A merchant finds one pearl of great price — and sells everything to get it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, _____ ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
Cold Open.verse: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
Cold Open.note: Guidance with surround sound — a word behind you saying 'this is the way.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Lo, children are an _____ of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
Cold Open.verse: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
Cold Open.note: Solomon's psalm about building houses — and the best inheritance is children.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He that is _____ to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
Cold Open.verse: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
Cold Open.note: Self-control beats conquest — ruling your own spirit outranks taking a city.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be _____ unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
Cold Open.verse: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
Cold Open.note: Paul's job description for the Lord's servant — gentle, teachable, patient.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: No _____ that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
Cold Open.note: A promise to God's servants — weapons may be formed, but they won't prosper.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the _____ also.
Cold Open.verse: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
Cold Open.note: The sun and moon get a whole sentence; the stars get four words tacked on the end — 'he made the stars also.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and _____ are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
Cold Open.verse: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
Cold Open.note: The song of Moses and the Lamb — sung beside a sea of glass mingled with fire.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Flee also _____ lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Cold Open.verse: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Cold Open.note: Paul to Timothy — run from what drags you down, run toward what's right.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The Jews had light, and _____, and joy, and honour.
Cold Open.verse: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
Cold Open.note: The turnaround after Haman's plot fails — light, gladness, joy, and honour, in four quick words.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot _____ thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
Cold Open.verse: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
Cold Open.note: Solomon dedicates the temple and admits the obvious — heaven can't hold God, much less a building.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For he shall give his _____ charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
Cold Open.verse: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
Cold Open.note: The devil quoted this verse to Jesus in the wilderness — and conveniently left out a few words.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own _____.
Cold Open.verse: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
Cold Open.note: Said in his hometown of Nazareth — the crowd soon tried to throw him off a cliff.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will _____ their sin no more.
Cold Open.verse: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
Cold Open.note: The new covenant's finale — a God who chooses not to bring our sins back up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I will _____ and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
Cold Open.verse: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
Cold Open.note: The prodigal's rehearsed speech, worked out while feeding pigs in a far country.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not _____.
Cold Open.verse: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
Cold Open.note: God's commandments aren't a burden — love makes them light.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with _____ and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
Cold Open.verse: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
Cold Open.note: Spoken from the burning bush — the Promised Land's famous slogan, flowing with milk and honey.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For as he _____ in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
Cold Open.verse: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
Cold Open.note: Often quoted about mindset — in context, it's a warning about a stingy host's fake hospitality.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I will heal their _____, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
Cold Open.verse: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
Cold Open.note: The last chapter of Hosea — after all the heartbreak, God promises to love freely.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thou shalt not follow a _____ to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
Cold Open.verse: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
Cold Open.note: Ancient Israel's law against peer pressure — the crowd doesn't get to decide what's right.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He shall cover thee with his _____, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Cold Open.verse: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Cold Open.note: God as a mother bird — feathers for cover, truth for armor.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The Spirit itself beareth _____ with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
Cold Open.verse: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
Cold Open.note: The Spirit confirms what we can barely believe — we really are God's children.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
Cold Open.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
Cold Open.note: A wake-up call for Zion — the light has come, so get up and shine.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the _____; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
Cold Open.note: Part of Moses' blessings for obedience — leading the parade, not trailing behind it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the _____, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
Cold Open.verse: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
Cold Open.note: The new Jerusalem needs no sun or moon — God's glory is the light.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I go the way of all the earth: be thou _____ therefore, and shew thyself a man;
Cold Open.verse: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
Cold Open.note: David's deathbed charge to young Solomon — 'be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Consider the _____: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
Cold Open.verse: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
Cold Open.note: Consider the ravens — no storehouse, no barn, and God still feeds them.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy _____, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
Cold Open.verse: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
Cold Open.note: Abram's call — leave the country, the relatives, and the family home, for a land not yet named.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A good _____ is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
Cold Open.verse: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
Cold Open.note: Reputation over riches — a good name can't be bought, only built.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.verse: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
Cold Open.note: From the only psalm credited to Moses — Peter echoes it: a day as a thousand years.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his _____ to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
Cold Open.verse: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
Cold Open.note: God's sunshine doesn't check credentials — Jesus' reason for loving even enemies.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Those things, which ye have both _____, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
Cold Open.verse: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
Cold Open.note: Paul's teaching method — watch me, then do it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and _____ me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
Cold Open.verse: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
Cold Open.note: Samson's last prayer, in the temple of Dagon — eyes gone, hair growing back, one more push left.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: What man of you, having an hundred _____, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
Cold Open.verse: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
Cold Open.note: The lost sheep — first of three 'lost' parables in Luke 15, followed by a coin and a son.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his _____.
Cold Open.verse: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
Cold Open.note: Make your plans, by all means — but the LORD holds the pen for the next step.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I waited _____ for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
Cold Open.verse: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
Cold Open.note: The waiting came first; the new song came a couple verses later.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the _____ God.
Cold Open.verse: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
Cold Open.note: Peter's great confession at Caesarea Philippi — Jesus blessed him for it on the spot.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: I will seek that which was _____, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
Cold Open.verse: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
Cold Open.note: God as the good shepherd, seeking the lost — Jesus picks up the same picture in the Gospels.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be _____; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
Cold Open.verse: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
Cold Open.note: Moses' marching prayer whenever the ark set out — David echoes it at the start of Psalm 68.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he _____: and God saw that it was good.
Cold Open.verse: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
Cold Open.note: Day three: God names the dry land and the gathered waters, then signs off with his favorite review — good.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a _____.
Cold Open.verse: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
Cold Open.note: The faithful pilgrims longed for a better country — and God has a city ready for them.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD God planted a _____ eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
Cold Open.note: The first real estate in Scripture — a garden 'eastward in Eden,' planted by God himself.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with _____.
Cold Open.verse: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
Cold Open.note: The room shook after they prayed — and they went right on preaching boldly.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy _____; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
Cold Open.verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
Cold Open.note: Whatever's in your hands, give it full effort — there's no second shift after this life.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For ye shall go out with _____, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
Cold Open.verse: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
Cold Open.note: Creation applauds the return home — mountains singing and trees clapping their hands.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the _____ of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
Cold Open.verse: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
Cold Open.note: Nations streaming to God's mountain to learn his ways — Isaiah 2 has nearly the same words.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He that _____ not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
Cold Open.verse: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
Cold Open.note: Paul's logic — if God gave his own Son, what good thing would he hold back?

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am _____, then am I strong.
Cold Open.verse: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
Cold Open.note: Paul learned this when his thorn in the flesh wouldn't go away — weakness became the strong place.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For sin shall not have _____ over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
Cold Open.verse: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
Cold Open.note: Sin has lost its hold — believers live under grace, not under its rule.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For the law was given by Moses, but _____ and truth came by Jesus Christ.
Cold Open.verse: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
Cold Open.note: Moses brought the law — grace and truth arrived in person.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Jesus saith unto him, The _____ have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
Cold Open.verse: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
Cold Open.note: Jesus to an eager would-be follower — even foxes had more of a home than he did.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of _____ also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
Cold Open.verse: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
Cold Open.note: Eden had two famous trees in the middle — this one, and the one that caused all the trouble.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So then _____ cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Cold Open.verse: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Cold Open.note: Why preaching matters — faith arrives through the ear.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
Cold Open.verse: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
Cold Open.note: Roots below, building above — Paul mixes a garden and a construction site.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: _____ shall not rise up the second time.
Cold Open.verse: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
Cold Open.note: Nahum's word to Judah about Assyria's threat — this trouble won't come around a second time.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Not of works, lest any man should _____.
Cold Open.verse: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
Cold Open.note: The sequel to 'by grace are ye saved' — so nobody gets bragging rights.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy _____ end should greatly increase.
Cold Open.verse: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
Cold Open.note: Bildad meant it as a lecture, but it came true — Job's latter end was blessed more than his beginning.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The LORD _____; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
Cold Open.verse: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
Cold Open.note: From David's song of deliverance, sung after God rescued him from Saul — it's echoed in Psalm 18.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But these are _____, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
Cold Open.verse: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
Cold Open.note: John's purpose statement for his whole Gospel — written so you'd believe and live.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my _____.
Cold Open.verse: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
Cold Open.note: The Last Supper, eaten at Passover — bread taken, blessed, broken, and given.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Pleasant words are as an _____, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
Cold Open.verse: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
Cold Open.note: Kind words as health food — sweet going down, and good for the bones.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they _____ him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
Cold Open.verse: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
Cold Open.note: After the ascension, the disciples headed back to Jerusalem — not sad, but full of joy.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And to know the love of Christ, which _____ knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
Cold Open.verse: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
Cold Open.note: Paul prays to know a love too big to know — and he means it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly _____ unto all good works.
Cold Open.verse: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
Cold Open.note: The verse after 'all scripture is given by inspiration' — scripture fully equips.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, _____ not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
Cold Open.verse: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
Cold Open.note: Three verses before the eagles' wings — the God who never gets tired gives strength to those who do.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy _____, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
Cold Open.verse: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
Cold Open.note: Asked which commandment is greatest, Jesus reached for Deuteronomy 6 — all of you, nothing held back.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. _____ is of the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
Cold Open.note: Jonah's prayer from inside the fish ends here — and the very next verse, he's back on dry land.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art _____ to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
Cold Open.verse: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
Cold Open.note: Heaven's new song — the Lamb alone can open the sealed book, because he was slain and redeemed us.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a _____ of water, whose waters fail not.
Cold Open.verse: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
Cold Open.note: The promise for true fasting — a soul like a watered garden and a spring that never runs dry.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall _____, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
Cold Open.verse: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
Cold Open.note: One of the clearest Old Testament glimpses of resurrection — sleepers in the dust waking up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Feed the _____ of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
Cold Open.verse: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
Cold Open.note: Peter, once told 'Feed my sheep,' now passes the charge on to church elders.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
Cold Open.verse: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
Cold Open.note: The rebuilt temple looked small next to Solomon's — God promised its glory would be greater.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other _____, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
Cold Open.verse: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
Cold Open.note: Pentecost — the Spirit arrives and the disciples speak in languages they'd never learned.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep _____ before him.
Cold Open.verse: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
Cold Open.note: After a string of woes against idols, the true God appears — and everyone hushes.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a _____?
Cold Open.verse: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
Cold Open.note: Paul's chain of questions — no preacher, no hearing; no hearing, no believing.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Wherefore God also hath highly _____ him, and given him a name which is above every name:
Cold Open.verse: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
Cold Open.note: After the humility of the cross comes the exaltation — and a name above every name.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim _____ throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
Cold Open.verse: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
Cold Open.note: The Year of Jubilee — the line 'proclaim liberty throughout all the land' is engraved on America's Liberty Bell.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are _____, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
Cold Open.verse: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
Cold Open.note: Raised with Christ? Then look up — that's where he's seated.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The voice of him that crieth in the _____, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
Cold Open.verse: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
Cold Open.note: All four Gospels apply this voice to John the Baptist, preparing the way.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have _____ the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
Cold Open.verse: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
Cold Open.note: Job in the dark, still holding on — God's words mattered more to him than his next meal.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Strength and honour are her _____; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
Cold Open.verse: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
Cold Open.note: From the virtuous woman poem — dressed in strength and honour, and laughing at the future.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a _____ God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
Cold Open.verse: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
Cold Open.note: Jonah's complaint — he ran away precisely because he knew God would be merciful to Nineveh.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the _____ shall be the LORD'S.
Cold Open.verse: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.
Cold Open.note: The last line of the Old Testament's shortest book — the kingdom belongs to the LORD.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And whatsoever ye do in word or _____, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
Cold Open.verse: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
Cold Open.note: Words and deeds alike, done in Jesus' name, with thanks attached.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is _____.
Cold Open.verse: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
Cold Open.note: The sin of omission — knowing the good and skipping it anyway.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy _____.
Cold Open.verse: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
Cold Open.note: Jesus to faithful Philadelphia — hold on, so no one takes your crown.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let every thing that hath _____ praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
Cold Open.note: The last verse of the whole Psalter — everything with lungs is invited to the choir.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
Cold Open.verse: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
Cold Open.note: Don't brag about tomorrow — James says the same in his letter: 'ye know not what shall be on the morrow.'

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thy word have I _____ in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
Cold Open.verse: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
Cold Open.note: From the longest psalm, all about God's word — memorization as a defense against sin.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this _____ from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
Cold Open.verse: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
Cold Open.note: Gethsemane's prayer — honest about the cup, surrendered about the outcome.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I _____, that do I.
Cold Open.verse: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
Cold Open.note: Paul's honest confession of the inner tug-of-war — anyone who's tried to change can relate.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the _____ came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
Cold Open.verse: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
Cold Open.note: Solomon's dedication prayer gets answered in fire — and the glory so fills the house the priests can't enter.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For other _____ can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Cold Open.verse: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Cold Open.note: Paul the master builder says there's only one foundation worth laying.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul _____ for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
Cold Open.verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
Cold Open.note: A psalm of David 'in the wilderness of Judah' — the dry land outside matched the thirst inside.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the _____.
Cold Open.verse: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
Cold Open.note: Paul planted, Apollos watered — but only God makes anything grow.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many _____ have I made thee.
Cold Open.verse: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
Cold Open.note: A new name for a man still waiting on a son — Abram becomes Abraham, and the name itself is a promise.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in _____ made with hands;
Cold Open.verse: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
Cold Open.note: Paul on Mars' Hill, surrounded by Athens' idols — the Creator doesn't live in buildings.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my _____; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
Cold Open.verse: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
Cold Open.note: God's book of remembrance for those who feared him — they become his treasured jewels.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man _____, let him come unto me, and drink.
Cold Open.verse: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
Cold Open.note: Shouted on the last great day of the feast — an open invitation to come and drink.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of _____, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
Cold Open.verse: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
Cold Open.note: Paul links Genesis 1 to conversion — the God who said 'Let there be light' does it again in hearts.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be _____ of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
Cold Open.verse: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
Cold Open.note: The prophet Azariah's word to King Asa — a promise and a warning wrapped in one sentence.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And my spirit hath _____ in God my Saviour.
Cold Open.verse: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
Cold Open.note: Mary's song continues — she calls God her Saviour before her son is even born.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
Cold Open.verse: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
Cold Open.note: David closes his psalm on God's all-knowing presence by inviting the search.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a _____ received him out of their sight.
Cold Open.verse: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
Cold Open.note: The ascension — Jesus taken up while they watched, and a cloud closed the view.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Husbands, love your _____, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
Cold Open.verse: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
Cold Open.note: Paul's standard for husbands — love measured by Christ's self-giving.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, I will do a _____ thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Cold Open.verse: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Cold Open.note: God tells his people to stop staring at the past — he's making roads in wildernesses now.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and _____ spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
Cold Open.verse: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
Cold Open.note: Real beauty is inner — a meek and quiet spirit is precious to God.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And lead us not into temptation, but _____ us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
Cold Open.verse: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
Cold Open.note: The Lord's Prayer's last request — then the closing praise: thine is the kingdom, the power, the glory.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he _____ in mercy.
Cold Open.verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
Cold Open.note: Micah's name means 'Who is like the LORD?' — and his book closes by asking that very question.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Finally, brethren, _____. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
Cold Open.verse: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
Cold Open.note: Paul's last words to Corinth — four quick charges, then the God of love and peace.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the _____ is servant to the lender.
Cold Open.verse: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
Cold Open.note: The plain economics of debt, written about three thousand years before credit cards.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Peter went out, and wept _____.
Cold Open.verse: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
Cold Open.note: The rooster crowed, the Lord turned and looked at Peter — and these were his tears.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But God hath chosen the _____ things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
Cold Open.verse: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
Cold Open.note: God's recruiting strategy — the foolish and the weak, to put the wise and mighty in their place.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let us search and try our _____, and turn again to the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
Cold Open.note: In the middle of the lament, a call to self-examination — then turning back home.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the _____.
Cold Open.verse: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
Cold Open.note: Young Samuel's track record — every word he spoke for God landed; none fell flat.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And that every _____ should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Cold Open.verse: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Cold Open.note: The climax of Philippians 2 — every tongue confessing, echoing Isaiah 45:23.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: It was meet that we should make _____, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
Cold Open.verse: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
Cold Open.note: The father's answer to the resentful older brother — the prodigal's party was a must.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the _____.
Cold Open.verse: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
Cold Open.note: Before day one's light switch, the scene is dark, formless, and wet — with the Spirit hovering over it all.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
Cold Open.verse: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
Cold Open.note: From the psalm David gave when the ark came to Jerusalem — it reappears almost word for word in Psalm 96.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away _____ from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Cold Open.verse: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Cold Open.note: Paul quotes the first half; Revelation 21 echoes the second — God himself wiping the tears.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in _____; for thou shalt die, and not live.
Cold Open.verse: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
Cold Open.note: King Hezekiah's bad news — but he prayed, wept, and God added fifteen years to his life.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became _____, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
Cold Open.verse: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
Cold Open.note: The Christmas story as an exchange — he became poor so we could become rich.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty _____ in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
Cold Open.verse: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
Cold Open.note: God sends the storm after the runaway prophet — the sailors are praying long before Jonah is.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Out of the same _____ proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
Cold Open.verse: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
Cold Open.note: Blessing and cursing from the same mouth — James says it shouldn't be so.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Cold Open.verse: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Cold Open.note: David's prayer after Nathan confronted him — he asks for the joy back, not just the forgiveness.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy _____ name.
Cold Open.verse: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
Cold Open.note: David's prayer at the temple offering — the people gave so willingly that the king broke into praise.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thy words were found, and I did _____ them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
Cold Open.verse: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
Cold Open.note: Jeremiah devoured God's words like a feast — Ezekiel and John both eat scrolls later.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be _____ from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
Cold Open.verse: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
Cold Open.note: Paul's confident hope — away from the body means at home with the Lord.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the _____.
Cold Open.verse: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
Cold Open.note: The Preacher's famous shrug — 'under the sun' is his signature phrase, and nothing under it is new.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer _____ for his name.
Cold Open.verse: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
Cold Open.note: Beaten and released, the apostles left the council rejoicing — a strange kind of honour.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For from the _____ of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And as he lay and slept under a _____ tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and _____ one another, even as also ye do.
Cold Open.verse: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
Cold Open.note: Comfort and build each other up — Paul notes the Thessalonians were already doing it.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a _____ of fools shall be destroyed.
Cold Open.verse: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
Cold Open.note: Choose your company carefully — wisdom and folly are both contagious.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a _____: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
Cold Open.verse: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: There is a way which _____ right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like _____' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a _____.
Cold Open.verse: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
Cold Open.note: The guilty jump at shadows; the righteous stand their ground like a lion.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: O give _____ unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Cold Open.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Cold Open.note: A refrain that runs all through the Psalms and Chronicles — he is good; his mercy endures.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more _____ way.
Cold Open.verse: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
Cold Open.note: Paul's bridge into the love chapter — 'a more excellent way' turns the page to chapter 13.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In _____ and offerings.
Cold Open.verse: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
Cold Open.note: Malachi's pointed question — the people asked 'how?' and got a four-word answer.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And all the _____ of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the _____.
Cold Open.verse: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
Cold Open.note: Peter's tired reply after a fruitless night — the catch that followed nearly sank two boats.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is _____; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
Cold Open.verse: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
Cold Open.note: The young man in white at the tomb delivers the first Easter announcement — come see the empty place.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the _____ fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
Cold Open.verse: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the _____ of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
Cold Open.verse: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
Cold Open.note: Heaven announces the wedding of the Lamb — and the bride has made herself ready.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Every place that the sole of your _____ shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
Cold Open.verse: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Blessed is the man that _____ in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

Cold Open.note: The blessed man of Jeremiah, sketched as a riverside tree in the very next verse.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth _____ unto her.
Cold Open.verse: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
