Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my _____ is at hand.
Cold Open.verse: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
Cold Open.note: Paul senses the end is near — ready, he says, to be offered up.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a _____ to work.
Cold Open.verse: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
Cold Open.note: Half a wall in record time, despite mockers on the sidelines — the secret was a mind to work.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: _____ are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
Cold Open.verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
Cold Open.note: The Preacher's case for teamwork — and a couple verses later, a cord of three strands.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had _____ on him,
Cold Open.verse: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
Cold Open.note: The Good Samaritan — the outsider was the one who stopped to help.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was _____ unto him for righteousness.
Cold Open.verse: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
Cold Open.note: Paul reaches back to Genesis 15:6 — Abraham's faith credited as righteousness.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine _____:
Cold Open.verse: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
Cold Open.note: Right after 'love the LORD thy God' — the words go in the heart first, then onto doorposts and into conversation.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones _____? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
Cold Open.verse: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
Cold Open.note: The valley of dry bones — Ezekiel wisely leaves the answer to God.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many _____ there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
Cold Open.verse: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
Cold Open.note: An ancient author warning about too many books — every student's favorite verse.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: The _____ is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
Cold Open.verse: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Then will I _____ clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
Cold Open.verse: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not _____, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
Cold Open.verse: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the _____, and giveth grace to the humble.
Cold Open.verse: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
Cold Open.note: Peter quotes Proverbs 3:34 — God resists the proud and favours the humble.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of _____ there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
Cold Open.verse: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; _____ your ways.
Cold Open.verse: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
Cold Open.note: The whole message in three words — Haggai's wake-up call to a people who had stopped building.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: If ye love me, _____ my commandments.
Cold Open.verse: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
Cold Open.note: Said in the Upper Room the night before the cross — love and obedience, linked.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: It is good that a man should both hope and _____ wait for the salvation of the LORD.
Cold Open.verse: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
Cold Open.note: Written over Jerusalem's ruins — hope that waits quietly, without demanding a timetable.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder _____: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
Cold Open.verse: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his _____:
Cold Open.verse: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.verse: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with _____, eternal in the heavens.
Cold Open.verse: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.prompt: If we live in the Spirit, let us also _____ in the Spirit.

Cold Open.label: Bible Study

Cold Open.label: Bible Study
Cold Open.prompt: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put _____ in man.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: God is our _____ and strength, a very present help in trouble.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD make his face _____ upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee _____.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an _____ love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: It is of the LORD'S _____ that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD is good unto them that _____ for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be _____.

Recovery Grace.prompt: But my God shall supply all your _____ according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

Recovery Grace.prompt: All _____ is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
Recovery Grace.verse: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
Recovery Grace.note: 'Inspiration' here is literally 'God-breathed' — the Book has breath in it.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never _____ thee, nor forsake thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
Recovery Grace.note: In the Greek it's a pile of negatives — never, no, not leave thee — divine emphasis.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Let us therefore come _____ unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
Recovery Grace.verse: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
Recovery Grace.note: Come boldly — not sheepishly — to the throne. It's a throne of grace, not of grading.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: If any of you lack _____, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Recovery Grace.verse: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Recovery Grace.note: God gives wisdom 'liberally, and upbraideth not' — no lecture attached to the gift.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD is my light and my _____; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
Recovery Grace.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
Recovery Grace.note: Two rhetorical questions with only one honest answer: nobody, and no one.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: O _____ and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
Recovery Grace.verse: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
Recovery Grace.note: David invites a taste test — the LORD's goodness holds up under sampling.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: What time I am afraid, I will _____ in thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
Recovery Grace.note: David doesn't pretend he's never afraid — he just has a plan for 'what time' he is.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I will lift up mine eyes unto the _____, from whence cometh my help.
Recovery Grace.verse: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
Recovery Grace.note: The psalmist looks up at the hills, then looks past them — the help comes from higher still.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have _____ thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
Recovery Grace.verse: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
Recovery Grace.note: Called by name, bought back, claimed: 'thou art mine' is the tenderest deed of ownership.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: When thou passest through the _____, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
Recovery Grace.note: Note the 'when,' not 'if' — floods and fire are assumed; the company is the promise.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He shall feed his flock like a _____: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
Recovery Grace.verse: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
Recovery Grace.note: Lambs carried in his bosom, mothers gently led — Isaiah's shepherd runs a tender operation.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is _____:
Recovery Grace.verse: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
Recovery Grace.note: The invitation has a window — 'while he is near' — and mercifully, near is where He stays.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not _____ thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
Recovery Grace.verse: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
Recovery Grace.note: Spoken to Joshua before the Jordan: God goes BEFORE thee — He's already up ahead.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the _____ God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
Recovery Grace.verse: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
Recovery Grace.note: Covenant-keeping to a thousand generations — God's faithfulness has a very long memory.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He is the Rock, his work is _____: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
Recovery Grace.verse: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
Recovery Grace.note: Moses's song calls God the Rock — the one thing in the wilderness that never shifted.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, _____ thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
Recovery Grace.verse: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
Recovery Grace.note: Even Zephaniah, prophet of the great dark Day, ends with 'fear thou not' for Zion.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find _____ unto your souls.
Recovery Grace.verse: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
Recovery Grace.note: A yoke that gives rest instead of taking it — Jesus's equipment works backwards.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For where two or three are _____ together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
Recovery Grace.verse: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
Recovery Grace.note: No minimum attendance for the presence of Christ — two or three will do fine.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Blessed are the _____: for they shall be called the children of God.
Recovery Grace.verse: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
Recovery Grace.note: Peace-MAKERS, not peace-keepers — the blessing is on the ones who build it.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And Jesus said unto them, I am the _____ of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
Recovery Grace.verse: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
Recovery Grace.note: Bread of life: the staple, not the dessert — Jesus claims the daily necessities.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in _____, but shall have the light of life.
Recovery Grace.verse: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
Recovery Grace.note: Followers don't get a map; they get a light that walks in front of them.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have _____ the world.
Recovery Grace.verse: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
Recovery Grace.note: Jesus says 'I have overcome' the night before the cross — past tense, on purpose.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Let not your heart be _____: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
Recovery Grace.verse: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
Recovery Grace.note: Spoken in the upper room, hours from betrayal — Jesus comforts them on His hardest night.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Behold, I have graven thee upon the _____ of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
Recovery Grace.verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
Recovery Grace.note: Not a note on the fridge — your name engraved on God's own palms. He can't open His hand without seeing you.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be _____ us?
Recovery Grace.verse: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
Recovery Grace.note: Paul's closing argument begins: if God is for us, the list of real threats gets very short.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He giveth power to the _____; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Recovery Grace.verse: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Recovery Grace.note: Strength for the faint, power for the powerless — two verses before the famous eagles' wings.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my _____, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
Recovery Grace.verse: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
Recovery Grace.note: Quoting Psalm 118, the writer turns 'I will not fear' into something we can boldly say out loud.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: As far as the east is from the _____, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Recovery Grace.verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Recovery Grace.note: East and west never meet — that's exactly how far God moves our sins away. North and south would've had an end.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Yet I will _____ in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
Recovery Grace.verse: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
Recovery Grace.note: No figs, no fruit, no flocks in the verse before — and still Habakkuk says 'Yet I will rejoice.'

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Now the God of _____ fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
Recovery Grace.verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
Recovery Grace.note: Paul calls Him 'the God of hope' and prays you'll abound in it — overflowing, not just getting by.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand _____, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
Recovery Grace.verse: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
Recovery Grace.note: Sea in front, Pharaoh's chariots behind — and Moses's battle plan is 'stand still.' It worked.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the _____ is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
Recovery Grace.verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
Recovery Grace.note: David's pre-fight speech to Goliath: no sword needed when the battle belongs to someone bigger than the giant.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right _____, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
Recovery Grace.note: God holding your right hand while saying 'fear not' — like a parent crossing a busy street with a child.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the _____ of thine heart.
Recovery Grace.verse: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Recovery Grace.note: Delight comes first, then the desires — and the delight tends to reshape what you desire.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I will both lay me down in peace, and _____: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
Recovery Grace.verse: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
Recovery Grace.note: An evening psalm of David: lie down in peace and actually sleep, because Someone else is keeping watch.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I say unto you, that likewise _____ shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
Recovery Grace.verse: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
Recovery Grace.note: Heaven throws a bigger party for one returning sheep than for ninety-nine that never wandered.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Is any thing too _____ for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
Recovery Grace.verse: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
Recovery Grace.note: Asked after Sarah laughed at the idea of a baby at ninety. A year later, she named him Isaac — 'laughter.'

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Wait on the LORD: be of good _____, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
Recovery Grace.verse: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
Recovery Grace.note: Wait, take courage, wait again — David bookends the advice, because waiting is the hard part.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will _____; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Recovery Grace.verse: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Recovery Grace.note: Before they call, I will answer — God's reply is on the way before the prayer is finished.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD is my _____, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
Recovery Grace.verse: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
Recovery Grace.note: Jerusalem lay in ruins, yet the poet counts the LORD as his portion — and finds that enough to hope on.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Cast thy _____ upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
Recovery Grace.verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
Recovery Grace.note: Cast it, don't carry it. Peter echoes this centuries later: 'casting all your care upon him.'

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: We love him, because he _____ loved us.
Recovery Grace.verse: We love him, because he first loved us.
Recovery Grace.note: Our love is always a reply — He said it first, and we're just answering back.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good _____; it is I; be not afraid.
Recovery Grace.verse: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
Recovery Grace.note: Spoken across the waves to terrified disciples at night — moments before Peter steps out of the boat.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the _____ through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Recovery Grace.verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Recovery Grace.note: The end of Paul's great resurrection chapter: death has lost its sting, so it ends with a thank-you.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: _____ ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
Recovery Grace.verse: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
Recovery Grace.note: Isaiah turns from judgment to hope with a double 'comfort ye' — the first words sung in Handel's Messiah.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Many _____ cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
Recovery Grace.verse: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
Recovery Grace.note: Many waters cannot quench it, and no fortune can buy it — love's two best qualities in one verse.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a _____ heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
Recovery Grace.verse: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
Recovery Grace.note: God isn't nearest to the polished — He's nigh unto the broken-hearted, right where it hurts.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the _____ of the Almighty.
Recovery Grace.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Recovery Grace.note: The 'secret place' psalm — dwell close enough to the Almighty and you end up living in His shade.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Surely _____ and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
Recovery Grace.verse: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
Recovery Grace.note: In the Shepherd Psalm, goodness and mercy don't just wait for you — they follow you, all the days.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I will not leave you _____: I will come to you.
Recovery Grace.verse: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
Recovery Grace.note: The night before the cross Jesus promises not to leave them comfortless — modern versions say 'as orphans.'

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But the very hairs of your head are all _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
Recovery Grace.note: God's attention to detail extends to your hairline — every strand is numbered, even the ones leaving.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that _____ thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
Recovery Grace.note: Just after the bitter waters of Marah turned sweet, God introduces Himself by a new name: the LORD who heals.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And, behold, I am with thee, and will _____ thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
Recovery Grace.verse: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
Recovery Grace.note: Jacob is on the run from Esau, sleeping on a stone — and God promises to keep him everywhere he goes.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the _____ of his eye.
Recovery Grace.verse: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
Recovery Grace.note: The 'apple' of the eye is the pupil — the part you guard by reflex. That's how God guards His people.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in _____, even as thy soul prospereth.
Recovery Grace.verse: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
Recovery Grace.note: John's friendly opener to Gaius — a first-century 'hope you're doing well,' body and soul alike.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
Recovery Grace.note: A Beatitude that sounds backwards: the mourners are the blessed ones, because comfort is coming.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath _____ a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
Recovery Grace.verse: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
Recovery Grace.note: What God starts, He finishes — Paul writes this confidence in chains.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
Recovery Grace.note: A promise for the 3 a.m. worrier: lie down unafraid, and the sleep itself shall be sweet.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
Recovery Grace.note: Weeping gets the night shift; joy clocks in at dawn. The psalmist knows which one has the longer contract.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Yet now be _____, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
Recovery Grace.verse: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
Recovery Grace.note: Three 'be strong's for a discouraged rebuilding crew — the second Temple looked small, but God said 'I am with you.'

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because _____ is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
Recovery Grace.verse: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
Recovery Grace.note: Written to 'little children' — small in themselves, but greater is He that is in them.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Nay, in all these things we are more than _____ through him that loved us.
Recovery Grace.verse: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
Recovery Grace.note: Not just conquerors — MORE than conquerors. Paul rounds up even after listing every hardship he can think of.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
Recovery Grace.note: The angel calls Gideon a mighty man of valour while he's hiding in a winepress. God names you by where you're headed.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He is not here: for he is _____, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
Recovery Grace.verse: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
Recovery Grace.note: The angel's Easter sermon is short: he is not here, he is risen, come and see. Best news ever preached.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
Recovery Grace.note: Said right after the camel-through-the-needle line. Impossible for men, possible with God — big difference.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things _____. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
Recovery Grace.verse: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
Recovery Grace.note: From the throne itself: 'I make all things new.' Not all new things — all things new.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his _____ continually.
Recovery Grace.verse: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
Recovery Grace.note: Sung the day David brought the ark into Jerusalem — seek His face, and keep seeking it, continually.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I _____ you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
Recovery Grace.verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
Recovery Grace.note: From your first day to your hoar hairs, God promises to carry you — no retirement age on this one.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Draw _____ to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
Recovery Grace.verse: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
Recovery Grace.note: Draw nigh, and He draws nigh — the shortest distance in the Bible is one step toward God.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: My sheep hear my _____, and I know them, and they follow me:
Recovery Grace.verse: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
Recovery Grace.note: Sheep know their shepherd by sound, not sight — and Jesus says His know His voice the same way.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst _____, all things are possible to him that believeth.
Recovery Grace.verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
Recovery Grace.note: A desperate father's 'if thou canst' gets turned right around — and he answers, 'help thou mine unbelief.'

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of _____: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
Recovery Grace.verse: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
Recovery Grace.note: 'Prisoners of hope' — Zechariah's lovely name for people held fast by God's promises, with double to come.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be _____ with us than with him:
Recovery Grace.verse: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the _____ he had to her.
Recovery Grace.verse: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly _____: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Recovery Grace.verse: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
Recovery Grace.note: The promise in one phrase: eternal life — and the One who promised it keeps His word.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to _____ you.
Recovery Grace.verse: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Rejoicing in _____; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Recovery Grace.verse: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Recovery Grace.note: Three quick habits from Paul: rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: So shall thy _____ be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
Recovery Grace.verse: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
Recovery Grace.note: Honor God with your firstfruits, and your barns fill with plenty and your presses overflow.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good _____: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
Recovery Grace.verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For thou art my _____, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
Recovery Grace.verse: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
Recovery Grace.note: From David's song after deliverance from Saul: God is his lamp, lighting up the dark.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Wherefore _____ one another with these words.
Recovery Grace.verse: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
Recovery Grace.note: Paul writes about the Lord's return for believers who've died, then says: comfort one another with these words.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Continue in _____, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
Recovery Grace.verse: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
Recovery Grace.note: Paul's advice: keep praying, stay watchful, and season it all with thanksgiving.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and _____ in the Holy Ghost.
Recovery Grace.verse: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
Recovery Grace.note: God's kingdom isn't about menus — it's righteousness, peace, and joy.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the _____ of the world.
Recovery Grace.verse: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
Recovery Grace.note: John the Baptist sees Jesus coming and introduces Him with one picture: the Lamb of God.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And they said one to another, Did not our heart _____ within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
Recovery Grace.verse: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
Recovery Grace.note: Two disciples on the Emmaus road realize why their hearts burned as the stranger talked — it was Jesus.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Thy _____ come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
Recovery Grace.verse: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
Recovery Grace.note: The Lord's Prayer asks for heaven's kingdom to come and heaven's will to be done right here on earth.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Every word of God is _____: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
Recovery Grace.verse: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
Recovery Grace.note: Agur's proverb: every word of God is pure, and He is a shield to all who trust Him.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Thou art my _____ place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Recovery Grace.verse: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Recovery Grace.note: God as a hiding place who surrounds David with songs of deliverance — a shelter with a soundtrack.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: (For the LORD thy God is a _____ God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
Recovery Grace.verse: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
Recovery Grace.note: Moses's guarantee for the far future: a merciful God will not forsake thee or forget His covenant.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall _____:
Recovery Grace.verse: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
Recovery Grace.note: Amos's whole message in six words: Seek ye me, and ye shall live.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
Recovery Grace.note: In Luke's Beatitudes, the ones who weep now are promised a turn at laughing — tears are not the last word.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
Recovery Grace.note: Asketh, seeketh, knocketh — and no knock in this verse goes unanswered. Every one finds the door opened.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the _____, the first and the last.
Recovery Grace.verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
Recovery Grace.note: Jesus is the A to Z, start to finish — nothing comes before Him or after.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the _____ of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
Recovery Grace.verse: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
Recovery Grace.note: God doesn't just call us — He calls us into fellowship with His Son, and He's faithful to see it through.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise _____ out.
Recovery Grace.verse: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Giving _____ always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
Recovery Grace.verse: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
Recovery Grace.note: Giving thanks always, for all things — Paul doesn't leave much room for exceptions.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for _____ and might are his:
Recovery Grace.verse: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
Recovery Grace.note: Daniel's praise after God revealed the king's dream to him in a night vision.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He maketh me to lie down in green _____: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
Recovery Grace.verse: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never _____, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
Recovery Grace.verse: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Saying, The Lord is _____ indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
Recovery Grace.verse: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good _____ through grace,
Recovery Grace.verse: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is _____ before God?
Recovery Grace.verse: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Cast not away therefore your _____, which hath great recompence of reward.
Recovery Grace.verse: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath _____ to all men,

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
Recovery Grace.note: Love runs in the family: everyone who loves is born of God.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall _____; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
Recovery Grace.verse: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
Recovery Grace.note: Luke puts this right after a parable about a friend knocking at midnight for bread — persistence pays.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And they shall see his _____; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
Recovery Grace.verse: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

Recovery Grace.verse: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.verse: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

Recovery Grace.verse: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word

Recovery Grace.prompt: Till he fill thy mouth with _____, and thy lips with rejoicing.
Recovery Grace.verse: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
Recovery Grace.note: Bildad got this one right: God will yet fill thy mouth with laughing — and by the last chapter, Job is restored double.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an _____ of God through Christ.
Recovery Grace.verse: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
Recovery Grace.note: No longer a servant but a son — and sons inherit. Paul says you're an heir of God.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But the word of the Lord _____ for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
Recovery Grace.verse: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
Recovery Grace.note: Peter quotes Isaiah 40: the grass withers and the flower falls, but the word of the Lord endureth for ever.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Some trust in _____, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
Recovery Grace.verse: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
Recovery Grace.note: Some trust in chariots and some in horses; David's people bring something better — the name of the LORD.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to _____;
Recovery Grace.verse: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
Recovery Grace.note: God giveth us richly all things to enjoy — Paul's reminder to trust the Giver, not the riches.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy _____, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
Recovery Grace.verse: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
Recovery Grace.note: The LORD looks at fearful Gideon and says: go in this thy might — strength God could already see in him.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Thou shalt also be a _____ of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
Recovery Grace.verse: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
Recovery Grace.note: God's people as a crown of glory held in His hand — treasured, not just tolerated.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Recovery Grace.note: David sought the LORD and was delivered from all his fears — not some, all.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
Recovery Grace.note: Moses asks for God's presence; God answers: thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: As one whom his _____ comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
Recovery Grace.verse: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
Recovery Grace.note: As a mother comforts her child — one of the Bible's tenderest pictures of God.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And Mary said, My soul doth _____ the Lord,
Recovery Grace.verse: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
Recovery Grace.note: Mary's song begins here — her soul makes the Lord bigger in her eyes, the way a magnifying glass does.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be _____, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
Recovery Grace.verse: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
Recovery Grace.note: Everything else may shake, but believers receive a kingdom which cannot be moved.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
Recovery Grace.note: The One who keeps you never dozes off — you can sleep because He won't.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Know ye not that ye are the _____ of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
Recovery Grace.verse: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
Recovery Grace.note: Paul tells the Corinthians they don't just visit God's temple — they are one.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Fight the good fight of _____, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
Recovery Grace.verse: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
Recovery Grace.note: Paul coaches young Timothy: fight the good fight of faith and lay hold on eternal life.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
Recovery Grace.note: The prophet Azariah to King Asa: don't let your hands go weak — your work shall be rewarded.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The _____ appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
Recovery Grace.verse: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
Recovery Grace.note: Winter's over, flowers are up, the birds are singing — the Bible's prettiest spring morning.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
Recovery Grace.note: Joshua and Caleb's plea: if the LORD delights in us, He'll bring us into a land of milk and honey.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Let brotherly love _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: Let brotherly love continue.
Recovery Grace.note: Four little words open the last chapter of Hebrews: keep the brotherly love going.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the _____:
Recovery Grace.verse: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
Recovery Grace.note: John falls at His feet like a dead man, and Jesus lays a right hand on him: Fear not.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
Recovery Grace.note: God sends an Angel ahead to guard the road — and the destination is already prepared.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in _____, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
Recovery Grace.verse: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
Recovery Grace.note: The elder's happiest news: finding some of the children walking in truth.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: He _____ my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
Recovery Grace.verse: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
Recovery Grace.note: He restoreth my soul — the Shepherd doesn't just lead, He repairs.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I will be as the _____ unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
Recovery Grace.verse: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
Recovery Grace.note: God promises to be like the dew: Israel will bloom like the lily and send roots deep as Lebanon.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Grace and peace be _____ unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
Recovery Grace.verse: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
Recovery Grace.note: Peter's greeting doesn't just wish grace and peace — it wants them multiplied.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: When thou hast eaten and art _____, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
Recovery Grace.note: Eat, be full, then bless God for the good land — gratitude on a full stomach.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
Recovery Grace.note: Sparrows sold two for a farthing, and not one falls unnoticed — so you, Jesus says, are worth far more.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall _____ for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
Recovery Grace.verse: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
Recovery Grace.note: Moses reminds Israel: the God who fought for you in Egypt goes before you still — same fighter, new battlefield.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
Recovery Grace.note: The closing line of Jesus's 'Come unto me' invitation: His yoke fits, and His burden is light.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the _____ heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
Recovery Grace.verse: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
Recovery Grace.note: A heart transplant: out goes the stony heart, in comes a heart of flesh.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Can a woman forget her sucking _____, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
Recovery Grace.note: A mother might forget her nursing baby — unthinkable — yet even then, God says, I will not forget thee.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy _____; write them upon the table of thine heart:
Recovery Grace.verse: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
Recovery Grace.note: Wear mercy and truth like a necklace and write them on your heart — jewelry that never goes out of style.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Let us draw _____ with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
Recovery Grace.verse: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
Recovery Grace.note: An open invitation: draw near with a true heart — the way into God's presence is open now.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
Recovery Grace.note: The path of the just is like dawn, shining brighter and brighter unto the perfect day.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Truly the light is _____, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
Recovery Grace.verse: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
Recovery Grace.note: Even the Preacher, who called everything vanity, admits it: light is sweet, and sunshine a pleasant thing.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy _____, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
Recovery Grace.verse: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
Recovery Grace.note: Moses pleads he's 'slow of speech'; God reminds him who made man's mouth, and promises to be with his.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But God, who is rich in _____, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
Recovery Grace.verse: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
Recovery Grace.note: Paul's great turnaround words are 'But God' — rich in mercy, and loving us with a great love.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good _____ from a far country.
Recovery Grace.verse: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
Recovery Grace.note: Good news from a far country is like cold water to a thirsty soul — every traveler's family knows the feeling.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a _____: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
Recovery Grace.verse: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
Recovery Grace.note: Once a curse among the nations, now a blessing — so fear not, and let your hands be strong.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For ye were sometimes _____, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
Recovery Grace.verse: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
Recovery Grace.note: You used to be darkness; now you're light in the Lord — so walk like children of light.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and _____ are in his place.
Recovery Grace.verse: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
Recovery Grace.note: Sung the day the ark came to Jerusalem: strength and gladness live wherever God is.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be _____.
Recovery Grace.verse: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
Recovery Grace.note: Jesus wants His joy in you not as a sample but as a full measure.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Be ye also _____; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
Recovery Grace.verse: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
Recovery Grace.note: Like a farmer waiting for the rain, James says, be patient — the Lord's coming draweth nigh.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast _____ all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
Recovery Grace.verse: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
Recovery Grace.note: David's charge to young Solomon: be strong, fear not — God won't fail you until the Temple work is finished.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And I will _____ among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
Recovery Grace.verse: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
Recovery Grace.note: Even Leviticus has a love line: I will walk among you — God strolling with His people, like Eden all over again.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of _____ harvest.
Recovery Grace.verse: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
Recovery Grace.note: Naomi came home empty — right at barley harvest, the very season Ruth would meet Boaz.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy _____ is truth.
Recovery Grace.verse: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
Recovery Grace.note: In His prayer for the disciples, Jesus says it plainly: thy word is truth.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and _____ a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
Recovery Grace.verse: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
Recovery Grace.note: Jesus prescribes a retreat for His tired disciples — so busy they hadn't even had time to eat.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: I laid me down and _____; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
Recovery Grace.verse: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
Recovery Grace.note: Written as David fled from his son Absalom — and still he lay down, slept, and woke up safe.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their _____; and their works do follow them.
Recovery Grace.verse: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
Recovery Grace.note: A gentle promise for those who die in the Lord: rest from their labours, and their good works follow.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: But lay up for yourselves _____ in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
Recovery Grace.verse: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
Recovery Grace.note: Moths and rust can't reach heaven's vault — the only savings account thieves can't touch.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: _____, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
Recovery Grace.verse: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
Recovery Grace.note: Zephaniah calls Zion to sing, shout, and be glad with all the heart — the gloom has lifted.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have _____ thee, and not cast thee away.
Recovery Grace.verse: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
Recovery Grace.note: God to Israel: I have chosen thee and not cast thee away — called from the ends of the earth.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the _____ of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
Recovery Grace.verse: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
Recovery Grace.note: Paul's closing blessing to Corinth names grace, love, and communion in one generous breath.

Recovery Grace.label: Warm-Up Word
Recovery Grace.prompt: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my _____ shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
Recovery Grace.verse: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
Recovery Grace.note: Mountains may depart and hills be removed, but God's kindness won't budge an inch.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: I do set my _____ in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
Middle Test.verse: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
Middle Test.note: The KJV never says 'rainbow' — God simply sets his 'bow' in the cloud, a weapon hung up in peace.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: And he dreamed, and behold a _____ set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
Middle Test.verse: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
Middle Test.note: Jacob dreamed of a ladder, not a stairway — the song came much later than the KJV.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy _____ from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
Middle Test.verse: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
Middle Test.note: Moses at the burning bush: the KJV says 'shoes,' though most flannelgraphs drew sandals.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: Remember the _____ day, to keep it holy.
Middle Test.verse: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
Middle Test.note: The fourth commandment starts with 'Remember' — as if God knew we'd be inclined to forget.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your _____ will find you out.
Middle Test.verse: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
Middle Test.note: One of the most-quoted warnings in Scripture: your sin isn't lost, it's out looking for you.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my _____, we will serve the LORD.
Middle Test.verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
Middle Test.note: The plaque verse: Joshua speaks for his whole house, and countless hallway walls ever since.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: Where thou diest, will I _____, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
Middle Test.verse: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
Middle Test.note: Ruth's loyalty oath to Naomi goes all the way to the grave — 'where thou diest, will I die.'

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
Middle Test.prompt: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant _____. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
Middle Test.verse: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
Middle Test.note: Eli's coaching for young Samuel: 'thy servant heareth' — old-fashioned spelling, timeless posture.

Middle Test.label: Sunday School
