Deep Water.prompt: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the _____, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
Deep Water.verse: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
Deep Water.note: Jonah grieved a one-night plant more than Nineveh's 120,000 people — and the book ends on God's unanswered question.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore _____ life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
Deep Water.verse: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
Deep Water.note: Moses' closing appeal on the plains of Moab: two roads, heaven and earth as witnesses, and a strong hint which to take.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Thou art of _____ eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
Deep Water.verse: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
Deep Water.note: Habakkuk's honest complaint: if God can't bear to look on evil, why let wicked Babylon swallow people better than itself?

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For the word of God is _____, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
Deep Water.verse: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
Deep Water.note: 'Quick' is KJV for living, as in 'the quick and the dead' — Scripture is alive and cuts deeper than steel.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with _____.
Deep Water.verse: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
Deep Water.note: Haggai's audit for returned exiles who paneled their own houses while the temple lay in ruins: wages in a leaky purse.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy _____ love.
Deep Water.verse: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
Deep Water.note: Ephesus had sound doctrine, hard work and patience — and had quietly misplaced the love that started it all.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: A double minded man is _____ in all his ways.
Deep Water.verse: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
Deep Water.note: James's doubter is tossed like a wave — 'double minded' is literally 'two-souled' in the Greek.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But we have this treasure in _____ vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
Deep Water.verse: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
Deep Water.note: Gospel treasure in cheap clay pots — so no one mistakes the glow for the container.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish _____; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
Deep Water.verse: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
Deep Water.note: To Greek philosophers a crucified Savior sounded absurd — Paul agrees it looks foolish, and calls it power anyway.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But godliness with _____ is great gain.
Deep Water.verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
Deep Water.note: False teachers treated godliness as a way to get rich; Paul agrees it's great gain — just not that kind.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that _____, it shall die.
Deep Water.verse: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
Deep Water.note: The exiles blamed their fathers' sins; Ezekiel retired the sour-grapes proverb — each soul answers for itself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth _____ me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
Deep Water.verse: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
Deep Water.note: David refused a free threshing floor for his sacrifice — the same site where Solomon would later build the temple.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me _____, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
Deep Water.verse: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
Deep Water.note: Of twelve spies only Caleb and Joshua said 'we can' — Caleb finally claimed Hebron at eighty-five.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Is there no _____ in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
Deep Water.verse: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
Deep Water.note: Gilead was famous for healing resin; Jeremiah asks why, with medicine nearby, his people stay sick — the spiritual answers 'There is.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Although the fig tree shall not _____, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
Deep Water.verse: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
Deep Water.note: Habakkuk lists total crop failure — no figs, grapes, olives or flocks — and the next verse still says 'Yet I will rejoice.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of _____, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
Deep Water.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
Deep Water.note: Fresh off the Hall of Faith in chapter 11, the stands are full — so drop the extra weight and run.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a _____, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
Deep Water.verse: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
Deep Water.note: The Servant's resolve — echoed when Luke says Jesus 'stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a _____ of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Deep Water.verse: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Deep Water.note: The charter of Christian apologetics — the Greek for 'answer' is apologia, a reasoned defense, offered with meekness.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he is before all things, and by him all things _____.
Deep Water.verse: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
Deep Water.note: 'Consist' here means hold together — Paul says the glue of the universe has a name.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am _____.
Deep Water.verse: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
Deep Water.note: The ex-persecutor writes it in the present tense — 'I am,' not 'I was' — chief of sinners.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, _____ to meet thy God, O Israel.
Deep Water.verse: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
Deep Water.note: After five disasters ending 'yet have ye not returned unto me,' Amos stops listing and issues the summons.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin _____, grace did much more abound:
Deep Water.verse: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
Deep Water.note: The law exposed sin's size, but grace outgrew it — and Paul's next chapter heads off the 'so let's sin more' reply.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Behold upon the mountains the _____ of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
Deep Water.verse: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
Deep Water.note: Good news for Judah: Nineveh the oppressor is finished — Isaiah 52:7 paints nearly the same picture.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his _____ being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
Deep Water.verse: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
Deep Water.note: Daniel knew the lions' decree was signed and still prayed toward Jerusalem, windows open — not a protest, just his habit 'as aforetime.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I have planted, Apollos _____; but God gave the increase.
Deep Water.verse: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
Deep Water.note: Corinth was splitting into preacher fan clubs; Paul says preachers are just gardeners — the growth is all God's.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how _____ are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
Deep Water.verse: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
Deep Water.note: After three chapters wrestling with Israel's future, Paul stops arguing and breaks into doxology.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For they have sown the _____, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
Deep Water.verse: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
Deep Water.note: Hosea on Israel's idols and foreign alliances: plant nothing but air and you'll harvest a storm.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Beat your _____ into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
Deep Water.verse: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
Deep Water.note: Joel flips Isaiah and Micah's famous peace line into a call to arms for the valley of decision.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: There is no fear in love; but perfect love _____ out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
Deep Water.verse: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
Deep Water.note: John's fear diagnostic: fear expects punishment, and grown-up love has nothing left to dread.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: _____ in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
Deep Water.verse: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
Deep Water.note: God doesn't treat his people's deaths as statistics — each one is costly in his sight.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the _____ of life.
Deep Water.verse: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
Deep Water.note: 'Issues' means outflows — the heart is the wellhead, and everything downstream tastes like it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your _____ ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
Deep Water.verse: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
Deep Water.note: Fallow ground is land left hard and unplowed — Hosea says break the crust before expecting the rain.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that _____ the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
Deep Water.verse: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
Deep Water.note: Little foxes raided vineyards in bloom — small troubles can wreck a budding love.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to _____ God rather than men.
Deep Water.verse: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
Deep Water.note: Arrested again and ordered to stop preaching, the apostles explained the chain of command to the council.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Remove not the ancient _____, which thy fathers have set.
Deep Water.verse: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
Deep Water.note: Boundary stones marked family land; moving one at night was quiet theft of a neighbor's inheritance.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's _____: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
Deep Water.verse: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
Deep Water.note: Isaiah's opening rebuke: even an ox knows where to find its master's feeding trough; Israel doesn't.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Let the word of Christ dwell in you _____ in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
Deep Water.verse: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
Deep Water.note: Paul's prescription for church music: let the word move in and teach through psalms, hymns and spiritual songs.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a _____.
Deep Water.verse: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
Deep Water.note: Rebuilding Jerusalem's wall under threat: a trowel in one hand, a weapon in the other.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Being justified _____ by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
Deep Water.verse: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
Deep Water.note: 'Freely' is the same Greek word Jesus uses for being hated 'without a cause' — grace with no reason in us.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in _____ to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
Deep Water.verse: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
Deep Water.note: The Servant has a teacher's tongue for the weary — and gets his lessons fresh every morning.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: _____ ye, and believe the gospel.
Deep Water.verse: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
Deep Water.note: Jesus' first proclamation in Mark, in one breath: the time's up, the kingdom's here — turn around and believe.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin _____ at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
Deep Water.verse: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
Deep Water.note: God warns Cain before the first murder: sin lies in wait at the door — yet he can still rule over it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And no marvel; for Satan himself is _____ into an angel of light.
Deep Water.verse: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
Deep Water.note: Paul's warning about false apostles: deception rarely shows up looking dark — it dresses as light.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast _____.
Deep Water.verse: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
Deep Water.note: Jacob the heel-grabber gets a new name, Israel, after wrestling God until daybreak.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Be ye not as the horse, or as the _____, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
Deep Water.verse: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
Deep Water.note: Don't be a mule that needs bit and bridle to go where it's told — learn to come willingly.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are _____ already to harvest.
Deep Water.verse: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
Deep Water.note: Samaritan townspeople were already heading toward Jesus as he spoke — the 'harvest' was walking up the road.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without _____ and without spot:
Deep Water.verse: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
Deep Water.note: Peter's ransom price: not silver or gold, but blood — the perfect lamb, without a single defect.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten _____ grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
Deep Water.verse: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
Deep Water.note: The exiles' excuse proverb: our fathers sinned, we suffer — God answers that each soul answers for itself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not _____ against it.
Deep Water.verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
Deep Water.note: Spoken at Caesarea Philippi right after Peter's confession — Jesus pictures hell on defense, gates and all.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had _____ for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
Deep Water.verse: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
Deep Water.note: David's lament over Absalom, the son who tried to steal his throne — victory news that broke his heart.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And _____ not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
Deep Water.verse: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
Deep Water.note: Only a person can be grieved — and the same Spirit is the seal that keeps you until redemption day.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy _____ over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
Deep Water.verse: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
Deep Water.note: Ruth's bold marriage request at the threshingfloor — the Hebrew for 'skirt' is the same as the 'wings' of Ruth 2:12.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Dead _____ cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
Deep Water.verse: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
Deep Water.note: A few dead flies can spoil a whole jar of perfume — and a little folly, a big reputation.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I do not _____ the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
Deep Water.verse: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
Deep Water.note: 'Frustrate' means set aside — if law-keeping could make us righteous, Paul says, the cross was in vain.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But ye, brethren, be not _____ in well doing.
Deep Water.verse: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
Deep Water.note: Paul's tag after rebuking the idlers: don't let the freeloaders make you quit doing good.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to _____ we shall die.
Deep Water.verse: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
Deep Water.note: Jerusalem partied under siege; Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 15.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is _____ come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
Deep Water.verse: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
Deep Water.note: The Bible's last invitation: the Spirit, the bride and every hearer say come — and the water is free.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Woe to them that are at _____ in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
Deep Water.verse: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
Deep Water.note: Amos's woe to the comfortable elite of Samaria, lounging on ivory beds while the nation decayed.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a _____ land.
Deep Water.verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
Deep Water.note: Isaiah's portrait of a righteous king: shade from a great rock in a dry, exhausted land.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And let us consider one another to _____ unto love and to good works:
Deep Water.verse: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
Deep Water.note: The one good kind of provoking — church as a place where people stir each other up to love and good works.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Behold, he cometh with _____; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
Deep Water.verse: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
Deep Water.note: Echoing Daniel 7:13 and Zechariah 12:10 — the one they pierced returns in full public view.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock _____: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
Deep Water.verse: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
Deep Water.note: Told to speak to the rock, Moses struck it twice in anger — the water still came, but Moses lost Canaan.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open _____, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
Deep Water.verse: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
Deep Water.note: To Philadelphia, with only 'a little strength': an open door no one can shut — faithfulness outranks size.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our _____, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
Deep Water.verse: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
Deep Water.note: Paul's case for reading the Old Testament: it was written for us, to fuel patience, comfort and hope.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and _____.
Deep Water.verse: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
Deep Water.note: Mammon is wealth pictured as a rival master — Jesus says one heart can't run two payrolls.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not _____ to me.
Deep Water.verse: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
Deep Water.note: David stopped fasting when his infant son died — he would go to the child, but the child wouldn't come back.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a _____ from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
Deep Water.verse: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
Deep Water.note: Moses promised a prophet like himself; Peter applies it to Jesus in Acts 3:22.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For here have we no _____ city, but we seek one to come.
Deep Water.verse: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
Deep Water.note: Readers who'd lost property for their faith are reminded that no earthly city was ever permanent anyway.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a _____ in the night.
Deep Water.verse: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
Deep Water.note: Paul borrows Jesus' own image: the day comes unannounced, so live like the porch light's always on.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force _____.
Deep Water.verse: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
Deep Water.note: At 120, Moses still had sharp eyes and full strength — he didn't fade out, he was simply called home.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to _____.
Deep Water.verse: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
Deep Water.note: Jesus' mission statement on the Mount: he came to fill the Law and the Prophets full, not to tear them down.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be _____: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
Deep Water.verse: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
Deep Water.note: Jesus quotes this on the night before the cross, foretelling the disciples' flight (Matthew 26:31).

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: One Lord, one faith, one _____,
Deep Water.verse: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
Deep Water.note: Part of Paul's unity creed — seven 'ones' in three verses, from one body to one God and Father.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the _____ that overcometh the world, even our faith.
Deep Water.verse: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
Deep Water.note: The world-beater isn't willpower — John says the victory that overcomes the world is faith itself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a _____ stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
Deep Water.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
Deep Water.note: God's foundation stone for Zion — Peter applies it to Jesus in 1 Peter 2:6.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy _____ from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
Deep Water.verse: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
Deep Water.note: Before Jericho, Joshua meets the captain of the LORD's host and gets Moses' burning-bush instruction.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the _____.
Deep Water.verse: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
Deep Water.note: Asa had trusted God against a million-man army — but late in life he trusted doctors, not the LORD.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Thou shalt rise up before the _____ head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
Deep Water.note: 'Hoary' means white-haired — the Law told Israel to stand up when the elderly entered the room.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God _____ of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
Deep Water.verse: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
Deep Water.note: The question Micah would echo centuries later: what does God actually want? Fear, walk, love, serve.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Is it _____ to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
Deep Water.verse: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
Deep Water.note: Jerusalem in ruins calls out to people walking past: is there any sorrow like mine?

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and _____ you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
Deep Water.verse: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
Deep Water.note: Disciples don't apply for the job: Jesus did the choosing and appointing — for fruit that lasts.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For our _____ is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
Deep Water.verse: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
Deep Water.note: KJV 'conversation' means way of life — Paul reminds Philippi, a Roman colony (Acts 16:12), where its true citizenship lies.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the _____ of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
Deep Water.verse: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
Deep Water.note: At the second temple's foundation, the young shouted for joy while old men who'd seen Solomon's temple wept.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I drew them with _____ of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
Deep Water.verse: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
Deep Water.note: God led Israel like a father teaching a toddler to walk — with human ropes, with bands of love.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and _____, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
Deep Water.verse: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
Deep Water.note: Jude ends his warnings with one of Scripture's grandest doxologies — the last word belongs to praise.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into _____: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Deep Water.verse: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Deep Water.note: Isaiah's peace vision, and Micah 4:3 says it too — Joel 3:10 runs it backward as a call to war.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the _____ of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
Deep Water.verse: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
Deep Water.note: Israel traded a spring of living water for leaky handmade tanks — the two evils in one picture.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most _____ flame.
Deep Water.verse: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
Deep Water.note: The Song's climax: love strong as death, jealousy cruel as the grave, its coals a blazing fire.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And of some have _____, making a difference:
Deep Water.verse: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
Deep Water.note: Jude's fiery letter softens here: for the wavering, compassion first — care can make the difference.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be _____ of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
Deep Water.verse: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
Deep Water.note: One of Scripture's boldest lines: through God's promises, believers come to share the divine nature itself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And hope maketh not _____; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
Deep Water.verse: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
Deep Water.note: The end of Paul's chain from tribulation to hope: this hope won't embarrass you, because God's love is already poured in.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For bodily _____ profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
Deep Water.verse: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
Deep Water.note: Paul isn't anti-gym — bodily exercise profits a little; godliness pays dividends now and forever.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: (Now the man Moses was very _____, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
Deep Water.verse: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
Deep Water.note: A parenthesis in the middle of Miriam and Aaron's complaint: the man they criticized was the humblest on earth.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very _____ song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
Deep Water.verse: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
Deep Water.note: Ezekiel's audience enjoyed his preaching like a concert — and went home without doing anything.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Now ye are the body of Christ, and _____ in particular.
Deep Water.verse: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
Deep Water.note: Paul's body metaphor lands: the eye can't fire the hand, and every member of the church matters.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the _____ of my fathers unto thee.
Deep Water.verse: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
Deep Water.note: Naboth wouldn't sell his family vineyard to King Ahab — the Law forbade it, and Jezebel had him framed.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can _____ his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
Deep Water.verse: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
Deep Water.note: Nebuchadnezzar's confession after his season of madness in the fields: no one can hold back God's hand.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For we must all appear before the _____ seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
Deep Water.verse: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
Deep Water.note: Paul once stood before Gallio's judgment seat in Corinth itself (Acts 18) — his readers knew the picture.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have _____ the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
Deep Water.verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
Deep Water.note: Temple renovations turned up the forgotten book of the law, and King Josiah's great reforms began.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Little children, keep yourselves from _____. Amen.
Deep Water.verse: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
Deep Water.note: John's first letter ends abruptly on this line — anything that takes God's place is an idol.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and _____, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
Deep Water.verse: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
Deep Water.note: The first church's four habits after Pentecost: teaching, fellowship, bread and prayer — still a decent checklist.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Henceforth there is laid up for me a _____ of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
Deep Water.verse: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
Deep Water.note: Paul's last letter, with his 'departure' at hand: the crown isn't for him only, but all who love his appearing.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But as many as received him, to them gave he _____ to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
Deep Water.verse: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
Deep Water.note: The prologue's open door: not born into it by blood, but receiving him grants the right to be God's children.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of _____;
Deep Water.verse: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
Deep Water.note: The Thessalonians feared they'd missed the day; Paul says a falling away and the man of sin come first.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: (For the weapons of our warfare are not _____, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
Deep Water.verse: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
Deep Water.note: Paul's weapons aren't made of flesh — but they're strong enough to pull down fortresses.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD _____ up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
Deep Water.verse: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
Deep Water.note: Cyrus's decree freed the exiles to go home and rebuild — fulfilling what God had spoken through Jeremiah.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the _____ of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
Deep Water.verse: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
Deep Water.note: Leave the field's edges for the poor — the very law that let Ruth glean in Boaz's field.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But Jonah rose up to _____ unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
Deep Water.note: Sent to Nineveh, Jonah booked passage the other way, to Tarshish — paid the fare and everything.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Ephraim is joined to _____: let him alone.
Deep Water.verse: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
Deep Water.note: God's grim verdict on Ephraim's idolatry: leave him alone.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Thou shalt not _____ the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
Deep Water.verse: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
Deep Water.note: Let the threshing ox eat as it works — Paul uses it to say workers deserve their pay.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For a just man falleth _____ times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
Deep Water.verse: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
Deep Water.note: The righteous fall too — the difference is they keep getting back up.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for _____?
Deep Water.verse: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
Deep Water.note: Satan's question: does Job serve God only because God pays well? The whole book answers it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Keep back thy servant also from _____ sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
Deep Water.verse: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
Deep Water.note: Hidden faults in verse 12, deliberate sins here — David asks to be kept from both.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud _____ be stayed?
Deep Water.verse: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
Deep Water.note: God sets the sea its limits like a parent at a playpen: this far, and no further.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get _____, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
Deep Water.verse: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
Deep Water.note: Moses' warning for prosperous days: the power to earn is itself a gift, so don't forget the Giver.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: In your _____ possess ye your souls.
Deep Water.verse: In your patience possess ye your souls.
Deep Water.note: Jesus' counsel amid predicted wars and betrayals: you keep your soul by enduring, not by escaping.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither _____ nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
Deep Water.verse: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
Deep Water.note: Right after 'baptized into Christ': ethnic, social and gender lines don't rank anyone in God's family.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: In that day shall there be upon the _____ of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
Deep Water.verse: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
Deep Water.note: 'Holiness to the LORD' was engraved on the high priest's mitre — Zechariah sees it on horses' bells.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall _____ for ever and ever.
Deep Water.verse: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
Deep Water.note: The seventh trumpet's announcement — Handel set these very words in the 'Hallelujah' chorus of Messiah.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: My days are swifter than a weaver's _____, and are spent without hope.
Deep Water.verse: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
Deep Water.note: A weaver's shuttle flies back and forth faster than the eye can follow — Job says his days go like that.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my _____ with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
Deep Water.verse: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
Deep Water.note: Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders: chains awaited in Jerusalem, and he only cared about finishing well.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: That being justified by his grace, we should be made _____ according to the hope of eternal life.
Deep Water.verse: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
Deep Water.note: Grace does more than acquit the guilty — it writes them into the will as heirs.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your _____ are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
Deep Water.verse: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
Deep Water.note: Forty years in the desert and not one worn-out cloak or sandal — God's quiet wardrobe miracle.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early _____ it goeth away.
Deep Water.verse: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
Deep Water.note: Israel's devotion vanished like morning mist — gone before the day really started.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a _____ in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
Deep Water.verse: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
Deep Water.note: Paul never names his thorn — he asked three times for it to go and got 'My grace is sufficient' instead.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were _____ until the going down of the sun.
Deep Water.verse: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
Deep Water.note: Israel won against Amalek only while Moses' arms stayed up — so Aaron and Hur held them, one on each side.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: O death, where is thy _____? O grave, where is thy victory?
Deep Water.verse: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
Deep Water.note: Paul taunts death itself, borrowing Hosea 13:14 — a resurrection victory lap.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without _____ is dead also.
Deep Water.verse: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
Deep Water.note: James's closing analogy: faith without works is a corpse — the breath is gone, only the body remains.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose _____ and maker is God.
Deep Water.verse: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
Deep Water.note: Abraham lived in tents because he was looking for a city with foundations — designed and built by God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Enoch _____ with God: and he was not; for God took him.
Deep Water.verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
Deep Water.note: Enoch never died — just walked with God until one day he walked right on home.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I have set _____ upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
Deep Water.verse: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
Deep Water.note: Isaiah posts watchmen on Jerusalem's walls who are told never to stop reminding God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: That if thou shalt _____ with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
Deep Water.verse: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
Deep Water.note: Mouth and heart together: Paul's simplest summary of how a person is saved.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Now unto the King eternal, _____, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Deep Water.verse: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Deep Water.note: Recalling his own past as a persecutor, Paul can't help himself — he breaks into praise mid-letter.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the _____ say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
Deep Water.verse: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
Deep Water.note: Should a lump of clay argue with the potter about what he's making? Paul borrows the image in Romans 9.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the God of peace shall _____ Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Deep Water.verse: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Deep Water.note: An echo of Genesis 3:15 — the serpent's head-crushing promise, now coming 'shortly' under the church's feet.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be _____.
Deep Water.verse: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
Deep Water.note: Jonah's one-line sermon didn't even mention repenting — and the whole city repented anyway.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and _____, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
Deep Water.verse: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
Deep Water.note: Gentiles once outside the fence are now citizens and household — Paul piles on the welcome.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in _____ for his soul?
Deep Water.verse: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
Deep Water.note: Jesus prices the whole world against one soul — then asks what anyone could possibly offer to buy it back.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this _____ among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
Deep Water.verse: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
Deep Water.note: A mystery in Paul isn't a puzzle but a secret now told: Christ living in Gentile believers.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a _____ beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
Deep Water.verse: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
Deep Water.note: Paul sends Onesimus back to his master Philemon — not as a mere slave now, but as a beloved brother.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But they _____ the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
Deep Water.verse: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
Deep Water.note: Why Jerusalem fell: Judah mocked the very messengers God sent to warn them, until there was no remedy.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be _____; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
Deep Water.verse: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
Deep Water.note: Spoken right after the lamp-under-a-bushel saying: what's hidden now is only waiting for daylight.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a _____ of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
Deep Water.verse: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
Deep Water.note: Achor means 'trouble' — the valley where Achan was judged becomes a doorway of hope.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's _____ are the men of his own house.
Deep Water.verse: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
Deep Water.note: Micah describes a society in collapse; Jesus quotes it in Matthew 10:36.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: So they hanged Haman on the _____ that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
Deep Water.verse: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
Deep Water.note: Haman built a gallows for Mordecai — and the plot ran exactly in reverse.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be _____ therefore, and repent.
Deep Water.verse: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
Deep Water.note: Jesus to lukewarm Laodicea: the rebuke is love, and the cure for tepid is zeal.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before _____, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
Deep Water.verse: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
Deep Water.note: Moments after 'Judge not,' Jesus adds discernment: don't hand holy treasure to those who'll only trample it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Canst thou bind the sweet _____ of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
Deep Water.verse: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
Deep Water.note: The Pleiades is a star cluster and Orion a constellation — God asks if Job can bind the one or loosen the other.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: They fought from heaven; the stars in their _____ fought against Sisera.
Deep Water.verse: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
Deep Water.note: From Deborah's victory song: even the stars joined the battle against Sisera, along with a flash flood.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I am like a _____ of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
Deep Water.verse: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
Deep Water.note: A lonely sufferer compares himself to a bird of the wasteland — the next line adds an owl in the desert.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But the word is very _____ unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
Deep Water.verse: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
Deep Water.note: God's word isn't up in heaven or across the sea — Paul quotes this in Romans 10.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye _____ not, even as others which have no hope.
Deep Water.verse: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
Deep Water.note: Paul doesn't forbid grief — just hopeless grief; believers who've died are only 'asleep.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the _____; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
Deep Water.verse: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
Deep Water.note: Paul's charge to young Timothy: watch your life and your teaching — both have saving stakes.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the _____ of sins.
Deep Water.verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
Deep Water.note: Love refuses to keep a ledger — Peter likely echoes Proverbs 10:12, 'love covereth all sins.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For ye are bought with a _____: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
Deep Water.verse: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
Deep Water.note: Paul's closing argument in a chapter on purity: your body has been purchased — treat it as the temple it is.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again _____: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
Deep Water.verse: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
Deep Water.note: Naomi left Bethlehem with a family and came home with none — except a daughter-in-law who wouldn't leave.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Thou art _____, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
Deep Water.verse: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
Deep Water.note: The elders cast their crowns before the throne and sing — worthy, because he created all things.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But the wicked are like the _____ sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
Deep Water.verse: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
Deep Water.note: The restless sea keeps churning up mud — Isaiah's picture of a life with no peace.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live _____ with all men.
Deep Water.verse: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
Deep Water.note: Paul's realistic peace clause: 'if it be possible' — you can only control your half of the relationship.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the _____ of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
Deep Water.verse: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
Deep Water.note: David's one-item wish list: not victory or wealth, but time in God's house gazing at his beauty.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Neither is there any _____ betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
Deep Water.verse: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
Deep Water.note: A daysman is an arbiter who lays a hand on both parties — Job longed for one between him and God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For I was _____ to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
Deep Water.verse: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
Deep Water.note: Ezra had bragged to the king about God's protection, so he was too embarrassed to ask for a military escort.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the _____ of them that slept.
Deep Water.verse: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
Deep Water.note: Firstfruits were the first sheaf of harvest offered to God — Christ's rising guarantees the rest of the crop.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Mary said, Behold the _____ of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
Deep Water.verse: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
Deep Water.note: Mary's answer to Gabriel: no bargaining, no delay — just a servant's yes to the impossible.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' _____:
Deep Water.verse: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' sope:

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little _____ out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.verse: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.verse: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of _____.
Deep Water.verse: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.prompt: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy _____.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water

Deep Water.note: Psalm 2's warning to rebellious kings: pay homage to God's anointed Son before his anger flares.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we _____, when we remembered Zion.
Deep Water.verse: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Behold, I am _____; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
Deep Water.verse: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
Deep Water.note: Faced with God's questions from the whirlwind, Job finally puts his hand over his mouth.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the _____ grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
Deep Water.verse: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
Deep Water.note: From David's last words: a just ruler is like sunrise after rain on new grass.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Is not this the _____ that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
Deep Water.verse: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
Deep Water.note: Israel fasted and complained God didn't notice; he replied that the fast he wants is freeing the oppressed.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do _____ the Lord's death till he come.
Deep Water.verse: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
Deep Water.note: Every Lord's Supper is a sermon: the bread and cup proclaim his death — with a built-in 'till he come.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the _____ of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
Deep Water.verse: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
Deep Water.note: Peter's answer to the Pentecost crowd's 'What shall we do?' — about three thousand responded that day.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose _____ ye were healed.
Deep Water.verse: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
Deep Water.note: Peter calls himself 'a witness of the sufferings of Christ' — here he hears Isaiah 53 in what he saw.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in _____ of life.
Deep Water.verse: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
Deep Water.note: Baptism as burial and resurrection: down into death with Christ, up again to walk a brand-new life.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
