Deep Water.prompt: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the _____ would immediately cry out.
Deep Water.verse: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
Deep Water.note: Pharisees wanted the cheering crowd hushed on the road to Jerusalem; Jesus said creation itself would take up the song.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed _____? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
Deep Water.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
Deep Water.note: Moses doubted God could feed 600,000 men meat for a month; God answered with a sky full of quail.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Who is the image of the _____ God, the firstborn of every creature:
Deep Water.verse: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
Deep Water.note: Want to see the unseen God? Paul points to Christ — and the next verse says all things were created by him.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a _____ of blue:
Deep Water.verse: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
Deep Water.note: Fringes with a blue cord reminded Israel of God's commands — the woman in Matthew 9 touched Jesus' hem.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is _____ you.
Deep Water.verse: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
Deep Water.note: Asked when the kingdom would come, Jesus told the Pharisees to stop scanning the horizon for it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a _____ of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
Deep Water.note: Jesus quotes this as he overturns the temple tables — Jeremiah first said it in the temple gate.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath _____ death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
Deep Water.verse: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
Deep Water.note: Paul, writing from prison: Christ hasn't merely delayed death — he's abolished it and brought life to light.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The harvest is past, the _____ is ended, and we are not saved.
Deep Water.verse: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
Deep Water.note: Harvest came and went and no rescue arrived — the saddest end-of-season line in Scripture.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to _____ in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
Deep Water.verse: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
Deep Water.note: Paul's battle plan has a humble finish line: when you've done everything you can, stand.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the _____ of the Lord Jesus.
Deep Water.verse: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
Deep Water.note: Paul signs off Galatians pointing to his scars — the only marks in the flesh he cares to boast about.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: With him is an _____ of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
Deep Water.verse: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
Deep Water.note: Hezekiah sizes up Assyria for his people: their side has an arm of flesh, ours has God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be _____, and do exploits.
Deep Water.verse: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
Deep Water.note: Amid prophecies of a flattering tyrant, a promise: people who know their God will stand firm and act.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Thou shalt not go up and down as a _____ among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
Deep Water.note: The Law bans spreading gossip — right next to standing idly by while your neighbor's life is in danger.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: So they read in the book in the law of God _____, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
Deep Water.verse: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
Deep Water.note: Ezra's public reading came with explanation so the people understood — and they listened from morning until midday.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the _____ of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
Deep Water.verse: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
Deep Water.note: The tree of life, barred in Genesis 3, stands on both riverbanks — with leaves for the healing of nations.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither _____ nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
Deep Water.verse: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
Deep Water.note: Agur's prayer: not too poor to be tempted to steal, not too rich to forget God — just daily bread.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without _____ before him in love:
Deep Water.verse: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
Deep Water.note: Chosen before the foundation of the world — God's plan for his people predates the planet.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be _____ blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Deep Water.verse: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Deep Water.note: Spirit, soul and body — Paul prays for the whole person to be kept blameless until Christ comes.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a _____ mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
Deep Water.verse: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
Deep Water.note: David's charge to Solomon: serve God wholeheartedly, because he searches every heart and motive.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The days of our years are _____ years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
Deep Water.verse: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
Deep Water.note: A score is twenty, so threescore and ten is seventy — from the only psalm credited to Moses.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But _____ one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
Deep Water.verse: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
Deep Water.note: Daily encouragement as sin's antidote, while it's still 'To day' — a callback to Psalm 95 quoted just before.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, _____ thou bless me.
Deep Water.verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
Deep Water.note: Jacob wrestled all night and, hip out of joint, still wouldn't let go without a blessing.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was _____ on both his feet.
Deep Water.verse: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
Deep Water.note: David kept his vow to Jonathan by seating Jonathan's lame son at the royal table for life.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his _____ turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
Deep Water.verse: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
Deep Water.note: Solomon's foreign wives slowly turned the wisest king's heart to their gods.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself _____ from the world.
Deep Water.verse: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
Deep Water.note: James defines religion by orphans, widows and a clean coat — practice over performance.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the _____ for our sins.
Deep Water.verse: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
Deep Water.note: John defines love by propitiation — the sacrifice that turns away wrath — so it's no minor word.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Therefore being _____ by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
Deep Water.verse: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
Deep Water.note: After four chapters of courtroom argument, Paul announces the verdict — and its first fruit is peace with God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a _____ out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
Deep Water.verse: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
Deep Water.note: Balaam, hired to curse Israel, instead sees a star rising out of Jacob — a king far off.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For the LORD thy God is a _____ fire, even a jealous God.
Deep Water.verse: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
Deep Water.note: Moses warns against carved idols: Israel's God burns with holy jealousy over his people.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I _____ to the God of heaven.
Deep Water.verse: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
Deep Water.note: Nehemiah's arrow prayer: between the king's question and his answer, a silent word to heaven.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with _____ heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
Deep Water.verse: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
Deep Water.note: Peter's day-of-the-Lord forecast: the very elements melting — the ultimate controlled burn.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine _____ have we given thee.
Deep Water.verse: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
Deep Water.note: David's prayer over the temple offering: we only give back what came from God's hand in the first place.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this _____, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
Deep Water.verse: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
Deep Water.note: God's foundation bears a two-sided seal: he knows his own, and his own turn from iniquity.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: No doubt but ye are the people, and _____ shall die with you.
Deep Water.verse: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
Deep Water.note: Job's sarcasm to his know-it-all friends: when you die, wisdom goes with you.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people _____, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
Deep Water.verse: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
Deep Water.note: False prophets put bandages on a mortal wound and said all was well.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: We hanged our _____ upon the willows in the midst thereof.
Deep Water.verse: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
Deep Water.note: The captors asked for songs of Zion; the exiles hung up their instruments instead.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross _____, and follow me.
Deep Water.verse: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
Deep Water.note: Only Luke's version adds 'daily' — cross-bearing isn't a one-time event but a morning routine.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was _____ in those days; there was no open vision.
Deep Water.verse: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.
Deep Water.note: In Eli's day God rarely spoke — which is why young Samuel didn't recognize the voice calling him at night.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a _____ not turned.
Deep Water.verse: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
Deep Water.note: A flatbread burned on one side and raw on the other — Hosea's picture of half-hearted Ephraim.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I _____ him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
Deep Water.verse: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
Deep Water.note: Ahab's problem with Micaiah: the prophet only ever told him the truth.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be _____.
Deep Water.verse: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
Deep Water.note: Paul even includes himself and angels — the gospel's content outranks any messenger's credentials.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will _____ us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
Deep Water.verse: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
Deep Water.note: Nehemiah's answer to the mockers: God will prosper us, and you have no share in Jerusalem anyway.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and _____ to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
Deep Water.verse: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
Deep Water.note: Ezra hearing of Israel's intermarriage with idolaters tore his clothes and prayed red-faced.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be _____ to me a sinner.
Deep Water.verse: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
Deep Water.note: The tax collector's seven-word prayer went home justified; the Pharisee's speech about himself didn't.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of _____ fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
Deep Water.verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
Deep Water.note: Jesus explains his coming death in farm terms: a seed that refuses to die stays a lonely single seed.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the _____ of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
Deep Water.verse: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
Deep Water.note: Paul's one boast: the cross, which ended his relationship with the world in both directions.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Blessed is the man that endureth _____: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
Deep Water.verse: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
Deep Water.note: James's beatitude for the tested: endure it, and there's a crown of life waiting at the end.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and _____ neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
Deep Water.verse: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
Deep Water.note: Josiah became king at eight and never veered — right or left — from David's path.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to _____ life.
Deep Water.verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
Deep Water.note: Joseph, revealing himself to the brothers who sold him, reframes the whole betrayal as God's rescue plan.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: If thou hast run with the _____, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
Deep Water.verse: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
Deep Water.note: Jeremiah complained about his troubles; God answered that things were going to get harder.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can _____ nothing out.
Deep Water.verse: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
Deep Water.note: An echo of Job's 'naked came I out': we arrive empty-handed and leave the same way — so hold things loosely.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And take the _____ of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
Deep Water.verse: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
Deep Water.note: The armor's last pieces: a helmet for the head, and the only offensive weapon in the kit — the word.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Though he were a Son, yet learned he _____ by the things which he suffered;
Deep Water.verse: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
Deep Water.note: A startling line: even the Son learned obedience in the school of suffering — the most humbling classroom there is.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And they said one to another, We are verily _____ concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
Deep Water.verse: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
Deep Water.note: Twenty-odd years later, jailed in Egypt as 'spies,' Joseph's brothers finally say it aloud — not knowing Joseph understands them.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a _____ between me and death.
Deep Water.verse: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
Deep Water.note: David to Jonathan with Saul's spear still in mind: one step between me and death.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from _____ into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
Deep Water.verse: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
Deep Water.note: The origin of Purim: Esther's people turned the day appointed for their destruction into a feast.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon _____.
Deep Water.verse: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
Deep Water.note: Job pictures the earth hanging on nothing — a striking image for an ancient poet.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: _____ no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
Deep Water.verse: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
Deep Water.note: The one debt Paul says you can never pay off — love one another, and the law is fulfilled.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in _____ into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
Deep Water.verse: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
Deep Water.note: Priests entered yearly with borrowed blood; Christ entered once with his own — and it never needs repeating.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not _____ to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
Deep Water.verse: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
Deep Water.note: Ephraimites betrayed by their accent: they couldn't manage the 'sh' in Shibboleth at the Jordan fords.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how _____ I am.
Deep Water.verse: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
Deep Water.note: David asks God to show him how short life is — and in the next verse calls it a handbreadth.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The _____ is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
Deep Water.verse: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
Deep Water.note: Eli's daughter-in-law named her newborn Ichabod on the day the ark was captured — the glory had gone.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a _____ before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
Deep Water.note: Don't trip the blind or curse the deaf: the Law protects even people who'd never know who did it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of _____ life.
Deep Water.verse: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
Deep Water.note: When many disciples walked away, Peter answered for the Twelve: there's nowhere else worth going.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the _____ of hell and of death.
Deep Water.verse: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
Deep Water.note: The risen Christ to a terrified John: he holds the keys of death and hell — every locked door answers to him.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Let this _____ be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
Deep Water.verse: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
Deep Water.note: The doorway to Paul's great passage on Christ's humility — what follows is the mindset he wants copied.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Through faith we understand that the worlds were _____ by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
Deep Water.verse: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
Deep Water.note: Creation from nothing visible — the Hall of Faith's very first exhibit is the universe itself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not _____: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
Deep Water.verse: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
Deep Water.note: The Day of Atonement scapegoat carried Israel's sins off into the wilderness, never to wander back.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without _____:
Deep Water.verse: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
Deep Water.note: Paul's case from creation: the world is a signed masterpiece, so no one can plead total ignorance of the Artist.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that _____ on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
Deep Water.verse: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
Deep Water.note: Ahab's one great line: don't brag while strapping armor on — boast when you take it off.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much _____ enter into the kingdom of God.
Deep Water.verse: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
Deep Water.note: Paul said this soon after being stoned at Lystra and left for dead — he wasn't speaking hypothetically.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a _____ plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Deep Water.note: Spared like a burning stick pulled from a fire — and still Israel didn't return to God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The stone which the builders _____ is become the head stone of the corner.
Deep Water.verse: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
Deep Water.note: Jesus quotes this after the parable of the tenants — the rejected stone became the cornerstone.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he shall sit as a _____ and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
Deep Water.verse: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
Deep Water.note: The refiner sits watching the silver in the fire; he purifies the priests the same way, patiently.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live _____, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
Deep Water.verse: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
Deep Water.note: Grace is also a teacher — it says no to ungodliness and yes to sane, upright living in this present world.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the _____ of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
Deep Water.verse: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
Deep Water.note: Daniel's throne-room vision: the Ancient of days in white, his throne blazing like fire.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the _____ of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
Deep Water.verse: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
Deep Water.note: Even a king's heart is like irrigation water — God channels it wherever he chooses.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a _____ plucked out of the fire?
Deep Water.verse: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
Deep Water.note: The high priest Joshua, accused by Satan, is defended by God as a burning stick snatched from the fire.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a _____, that his name may be famous in Israel.
Deep Water.verse: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
Deep Water.note: The kinsman-redeemer was the relative who bought back family land — Boaz did, and Naomi got a grandson.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he _____ and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
Deep Water.note: Not wisdom, might or riches — the one thing worth boasting about is knowing God.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy _____; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
Deep Water.verse: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
Deep Water.note: Paul's 'O death, where is thy sting?' in 1 Corinthians 15 echoes this taunt of death.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; _____ our days as of old.
Deep Water.verse: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
Deep Water.note: Lamentations' closing prayer: turn us back to you, and make our days new as of old.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, _____ from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
Deep Water.verse: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
Deep Water.note: Believers as resident aliens: you're only passing through, so don't let the passions wage war on your soul.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: A false _____ is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
Deep Water.verse: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
Deep Water.note: Rigged merchant scales were a common cheat; God calls them an abomination and honest weights his delight.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: On that night could not the king _____, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
Deep Water.verse: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
Deep Water.note: One sleepless night, one boring chronicle, and Mordecai's forgotten good deed comes to light — God is unnamed but busy.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is _____?
Deep Water.verse: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
Deep Water.note: Samson's father asked the angel's name and was refused — then the angel rose up in the altar's flame.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face _____ while he talked with him.
Deep Water.verse: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
Deep Water.note: Moses came down glowing from Sinai and was the last to know — he later wore a veil when he spoke to the people.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be _____ to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
Deep Water.verse: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
Deep Water.note: James's three-part rule for every argument: fast ears, slow mouth, slower temper.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me _____?
Deep Water.verse: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
Deep Water.note: Told God would build him a lasting house, David sits before the LORD stunned: who am I?

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the _____ of the LORD it shall be seen.
Deep Water.verse: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
Deep Water.note: After the ram in the thicket, Abraham names the place 'The LORD will provide' — and it became a proverb.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no _____ to the LORD to save by many or by few.
Deep Water.verse: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.
Deep Water.note: Jonathan and his armorbearer took on a Philistine garrison alone: God can save by many or by few.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen _____ unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
Deep Water.verse: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
Deep Water.note: God to a nervous Ananias about Saul the persecutor: this man is my chosen vessel — now go.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: In whom we have _____ through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
Deep Water.verse: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
Deep Water.note: Redemption was the language of buying back a slave or captive — Paul names the price: his blood.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor _____ hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
Deep Water.verse: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
Deep Water.note: Two mites into the temple treasury — Jesus did the math and said she outgave every wealthy donor.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: It is he that sitteth upon the _____ of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
Deep Water.verse: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
Deep Water.note: God enthroned above the earth's vault, where human beings look like grasshoppers.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for _____.
Deep Water.verse: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
Deep Water.note: The river flowing from Ezekiel's visionary temple grows trees with healing leaves — Revelation 22 echoes it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: O _____ man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
Deep Water.verse: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
Deep Water.note: Paul's cry from the tug-of-war within — answered one verse later: 'I thank God through Jesus Christ.'

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I am Alpha and Omega, the _____ and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
Deep Water.verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
Deep Water.note: Alpha and Omega are the first and last letters of the Greek alphabet — God bookends everything.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor _____ heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
Deep Water.verse: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
Deep Water.note: Often read as describing heaven, but the next verse says God has revealed these things to us by his Spirit.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Whosoever _____, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
Deep Water.verse: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
Deep Water.note: The elder warns: whoever wanders off from Christ's teaching has wandered away from God himself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is _____.
Deep Water.verse: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
Deep Water.note: The last words of Ezekiel name the restored city — after all the exile, its whole identity is God's presence.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to _____, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
Deep Water.verse: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
Deep Water.note: Writing in chains, Paul is torn: heaven is far better, but the Philippians still need him here.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a _____.
Deep Water.verse: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
Deep Water.note: Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, and every curse came out as a blessing.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And being found in fashion as a man, he _____ himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
Deep Water.verse: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
Deep Water.note: The lowest step of the descent: from the form of God to a servant to a criminal's cross.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to _____ them that are tempted.
Deep Water.verse: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
Deep Water.note: Succour means run to help — and he can, because he faced temptation himself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But _____ the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
Deep Water.verse: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
Deep Water.note: Truth without love is a club; love without truth is a fog — Paul wants both, and growth follows.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: I have heard many such things: _____ comforters are ye all.
Deep Water.verse: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
Deep Water.note: Job's verdict on his three friends' counsel: comforters who made everything worse.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S _____? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
Deep Water.verse: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
Deep Water.note: After the golden calf, Moses draws a line in the camp gate — and the tribe of Levi steps over it.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and _____ it before the LORD.
Deep Water.verse: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
Deep Water.note: Hezekiah got Assyria's threatening letter and spread it out before God in the temple.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: It is good for me that I have been _____; that I might learn thy statutes.
Deep Water.verse: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
Deep Water.note: The psalmist's surprising thank-you note: trouble taught him what easy days never did.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good _____, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
Deep Water.verse: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
Deep Water.note: Four lepers found the Syrian camp abandoned and realized keeping the good news to themselves was wrong.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our _____ are upon thee.
Deep Water.verse: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
Deep Water.note: King Jehoshaphat, facing three armies, prays the most honest prayer: we don't know what to do — we're looking at you.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: A little leaven leaveneth the whole _____.
Deep Water.verse: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
Deep Water.note: Paul's kitchen proverb about false teaching — he uses the very same line in 1 Corinthians 5:6.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not _____: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
Deep Water.verse: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
Deep Water.note: Pharisees grumbled about Jesus dining with tax collectors, so he assigned them homework: go study Hosea 6:6.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the _____ image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
Deep Water.verse: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
Deep Water.note: The Son is the exact imprint of God's being — like a seal's impression matching the signet itself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the _____ of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
Deep Water.verse: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
Deep Water.note: The sheep-and-goats judgment: kindness to the overlooked turns out to have been done to the King himself.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be _____.
Deep Water.verse: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
Deep Water.note: The Preacher's prayer advice: God is in heaven and you are on earth, so keep it brief.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the _____.
Deep Water.verse: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
Deep Water.note: A proverb Peter also quotes in his first letter: God opposes the proud, but keeps giving grace to the humble.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief _____ stone;
Deep Water.verse: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
Deep Water.note: Apostles and prophets form the foundation; Christ is the cornerstone everything else lines up with.

Deep Water.label: Deep Water
Deep Water.prompt: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the _____ of all people:
Deep Water.verse: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
Deep Water.note: God didn't choose Israel for its size — it was the smallest nation, loved simply because he loved them.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And I will put _____ between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
Pulpit Ready.note: The protoevangelium — the first gospel promise, preached in Eden with one old word: enmity.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: The _____ shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
Pulpit Ready.verse: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
Pulpit Ready.note: Jacob's deathbed prophecy of Messiah's tribe — and yes, the KJV spells it the British way.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to _____ than the fat of rams.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
Pulpit Ready.note: Samuel to Saul: obedience beats ritual. To 'hearken' is to listen with every intention of obeying.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Purge me with _____, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Pulpit Ready.note: The little branch priests used for sprinkling blood — David asks for the sinner's scrub brush.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the _____ clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
Pulpit Ready.verse: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Miry clay' is mud that grips. The pit was horrible, the clay was miry, and the rock was neither.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the _____ of his friend.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
Pulpit Ready.note: Everyone quotes 'sharpens another'; the KJV sharpens 'the countenance of his friend.'

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the _____ of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
Pulpit Ready.verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
Pulpit Ready.note: The heavy word at the heart of Isaiah 53: his chastisement, our peace.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was _____ in the house of my friends.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
Pulpit Ready.note: A haunting line preachers have long heard echoing toward Calvary: wounded in the house of friends.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Ye blind guides, which strain at a _____, and swallow a camel.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
Pulpit Ready.note: Strain at a gnat, swallow a camel — the smallest unclean creature versus the largest.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: For what shall it _____ a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
Pulpit Ready.verse: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
Pulpit Ready.note: The KJV frames the soul as a ledger entry: what shall it 'profit' a man? Bad trade, says Jesus.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may _____ you as wheat:
Pulpit Ready.verse: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
Pulpit Ready.note: Satan asked to run Peter through the sieve. Jesus' answer, next verse: 'I have prayed for thee.'

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he _____ set his face to go to Jerusalem,
Pulpit Ready.verse: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
Pulpit Ready.note: The KJV spells it 'stedfastly' — no first 'a.' Jesus set his face toward Jerusalem and the cross.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness _____ it not.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
Pulpit Ready.note: Where modern versions say 'overcome,' the KJV says the darkness 'comprehended it not.'

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: In my Father's house are many _____: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
Pulpit Ready.verse: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Mansions' from the Latin mansio — a dwelling place. The KJV made heaven's real estate famous.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And as he reasoned of righteousness, _____, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
Pulpit Ready.note: Paul preached self-control — 'temperance' — to a governor who had none, and Felix trembled.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Whom God hath set forth to be a _____ through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
Pulpit Ready.verse: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
Pulpit Ready.note: The great atonement word: a sacrifice that satisfies. Every seminarian's flashcard, right here.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of _____. For without the law sin was dead.
Pulpit Ready.verse: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Concupiscence' — runaway desire, and possibly the hardest word to pronounce in the whole KJV.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your _____ service.
Pulpit Ready.verse: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
Pulpit Ready.note: Your 'reasonable service' — worship that makes sense. Modern versions say 'spiritual worship.'

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Be not deceived: evil _____ corrupt good manners.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Evil communications corrupt good manners' — the KJV's rendering of 'bad company.'

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a _____.
Pulpit Ready.verse: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
Pulpit Ready.note: Paul's fear after preaching to others: being 'a castaway' — disqualified, washed up on shore.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Wherefore the law was our _____ to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Pulpit Ready.note: The law as 'schoolmaster' — the tutor who walks you to class, then hands you over to Christ.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he _____ together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
Pulpit Ready.verse: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Quickened' means made alive — the KJV's resurrection verb hiding in plain sight.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not _____ to be equal with God:
Pulpit Ready.verse: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
Pulpit Ready.note: He 'thought it not robbery' to be equal with God — equality wasn't stolen goods; it was his.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: But made himself of no _____, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
Pulpit Ready.verse: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
Pulpit Ready.note: He 'made himself of no reputation' — the KJV's rendering of the great self-emptying, the kenosis.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, _____ of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
Pulpit Ready.verse: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Bowels of mercies' — the KJV locates compassion in the gut, which is honest anatomy.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And that ye _____ to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
Pulpit Ready.verse: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Study to be quiet' — the one homework assignment nearly everyone fails.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: For the mystery of _____ doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
Pulpit Ready.verse: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'The mystery of iniquity' — lawlessness already at work, still wearing its disguise.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a _____ people, zealous of good works.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Peculiar' meant 'his own treasured possession,' not 'odd' — though the church manages both.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Which in time past was to thee _____, but now profitable to thee and to me:
Pulpit Ready.verse: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
Pulpit Ready.note: A pun on Onesimus, whose name means 'useful': once unprofitable, now profitable.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no _____.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
Pulpit Ready.note: No shedding of blood, no 'remission' — the sending away of sin, the canceling of the debt.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Let us hold fast the _____ of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
Pulpit Ready.verse: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
Pulpit Ready.note: The KJV holds fast the 'profession' of our faith — the thing you said out loud. Don't waver.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and _____ of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Superfluity of naughtiness' — overflowing leftover wickedness. The KJV at its most quotable.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very _____, and of tender mercy.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Very pitiful' meant full of pity — the word drifted over the centuries; the tender mercy didn't.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: To an inheritance _____, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
Pulpit Ready.verse: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
Pulpit Ready.note: An inheritance 'incorruptible' — Peter's triple-negative treasure: cannot rot, stain, or fade.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: For we have not followed cunningly devised _____, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
Pulpit Ready.verse: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
Pulpit Ready.note: Not 'cunningly devised fables' — Peter's defense rests on eyewitnesses, not storytellers.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an _____ with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
Pulpit Ready.verse: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Advocate' — the parakletos, defense counsel. When you sin, you have a lawyer who never loses.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you _____ before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
Pulpit Ready.verse: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
Pulpit Ready.note: Presented 'faultless' — not merely forgiven, but with not a single charge left standing.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with _____ which cannot be uttered.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
Pulpit Ready.note: When words fail, the Spirit intercedes with 'groanings which cannot be uttered' — prayer below language.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually _____.
Pulpit Ready.verse: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
Pulpit Ready.note: The natural man can't grade spiritual things — they are 'spiritually discerned,' says Paul.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: In a moment, in the _____ of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
Pulpit Ready.verse: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
Pulpit Ready.note: Not the twinkle itself — the 'twinkling,' the split second an eye takes to glint. Resurrection speed.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter _____, but the spirit giveth life.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'The letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life' — the most quoted hermeneutics lecture in history.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Now then we are _____ for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Ambassadors for Christ' — the embassy metaphor every missions sermon borrows from this verse.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not _____ again with the yoke of bondage.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
Pulpit Ready.note: Liberty can be re-lost: 'entangled again with the yoke of bondage' — Paul's picture of a snagged harness.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the _____ riches of Christ;
Pulpit Ready.verse: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Unsearchable riches' — wealth no audit reaches the bottom of, preached by 'less than the least.'

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead _____.
Pulpit Ready.verse: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
Pulpit Ready.note: The whole 'fulness of the Godhead' dwells in him 'bodily' — a complete Christology in one adverb.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: For there is one God, and one _____ between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
Pulpit Ready.verse: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
Pulpit Ready.note: One God, one 'mediator' — the go-between. The word every communion meditation leans on.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in _____, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
Pulpit Ready.note: In the KJV, 'conversation' means conduct — your whole walk, not your small talk.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my _____, I have kept the faith:
Pulpit Ready.verse: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
Pulpit Ready.note: Paul finished his 'course' — the race-lane. Modern versions say 'race'; the KJV keeps the track.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a _____ of them that diligently seek him.
Pulpit Ready.verse: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
Pulpit Ready.note: Faith believes two things, says Hebrews: that God is, and that he is a 'rewarder' of diligent seekers.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The _____ fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Effectual fervent prayer' — one Greek word, two KJV adjectives, and much availing.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were _____ and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
Pulpit Ready.verse: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Unlearned and ignorant' — no rabbinic training, yet people could tell they'd been with Jesus.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only _____ of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
Pulpit Ready.verse: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Only begotten' — the KJV's phrase for the unique Son, echoed two chapters later in John 3:16.

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Be ye not _____ yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
Pulpit Ready.verse: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
Pulpit Ready.note: 'Unequally yoked' — like an ox and an ass in one harness, which the Law forbade (Deuteronomy 22:10).

Pulpit Ready.label: Don't Play With Me
Pulpit Ready.prompt: Because _____ is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
